src/pages/Home.tsx:
content: "import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { subjects } from '../data/subjects'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { ChevronRight, Star, BookOpen, Users } from 'lucide-react'; import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'; import SecretHub from '../components/SecretHub'; import { useAuth } from 'zite-auth-sdk'; const SECRET_CODE = 'genizy'; export default function Home() { const { user, isLoading, loginWithRedirect } = useAuth(); const [listening, setListening] = useState(false); const [typed, setTyped] = useState(''); const [hubOpen, setHubOpen] = useState(false); const handleBadgeClick = () => { setListening(true); setTyped(''); }; const handleKeyDown = useCallback((e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (!listening) return; const next = (typed + e.key).slice(-SECRET_CODE.length); setTyped(next); if (next === SECRET_CODE) { setHubOpen(true); setListening(false); setTyped(''); } }, [listening, typed]); useEffect(() => { window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown); return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown); }, [handleKeyDown]); // Stop listening after 5 seconds of inactivity useEffect(() => { if (!listening) return; const timer = setTimeout(() => { setListening(false); setTyped(''); }, 5000); return () => clearTimeout(timer); }, [listening, typed]); useEffect(() => { if (!isLoading && !user) { loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href }); } }, [isLoading, user]); if (isLoading || !user) return null; return ( <div> <AnimatePresence> {hubOpen && <SecretHub onClose={() => setHubOpen(false)} />} </AnimatePresence> {/* Hero */} <section className="relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/10 via-background to-secondary/10 py-20 px-4"> <div className="container mx-auto text-center max-w-3xl"> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}> <div onClick={handleBadgeClick} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm font-medium mb-6 cursor-default select-none" > <Star className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" /> Free Learning for Everyone </div> <h1 className="text-5xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold text-foreground mb-4 leading-tight"> Learn Anything,<br /> <span className="text-primary">Anytime.</span> </h1> <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground mb-8 max-w-xl mx-auto"> Explore interactive lessons across 8 subjects. Build skills, earn confidence, and discover the joy of learning. </p> <div className="flex justify-center gap-8 mb-2"> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">8</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Subjects</div> </div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">32+</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Lessons</div> </div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">100%</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Free</div> </div> </div> </motion.div> </div> </section> {/* Subjects Grid */} <section className="container mx-auto px-4 py-16"> <div className="text-center mb-12"> <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">Choose a Subject</h2> <p className="text-muted-foreground">Click any subject to start learning</p> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"> {subjects.map((subject, i) => ( <motion.div key={subject.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.07 }} > <Link to={`/subject/${subject.id}`}> <div className={`group rounded-2xl border-2 ${subject.borderColor} ${subject.bgColor} p-6 h-full hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 cursor-pointer`}> <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{subject.emoji}</div> <h3 className={`text-xl font-bold mb-1 ${subject.color}`}>{subject.name}</h3> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{subject.tagline}</p> <div className="flex items-center justify-between"> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"> <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3" /> {subject.lessons.length} lessons </span> <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 ${subject.color} group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform`} /> </div> </div> </Link> </motion.div> ))} </div> </section> {/* Footer Banner */} <section className="bg-primary/5 border-t border-border py-12 px-4 mt-8"> <div className="container mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 max-w-4xl"> <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" /> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">Built for Curious Learners</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">From elementary to high school — all levels welcome</div> </div> </div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center md:text-right"> EduWorld • Free Educational Resources </div> </div> </section> </div> ); } "

2px)", md: "calc(var(--radius) - 2px)", sm: "calc(var(--radius) - 4px)", }, boxShadow: { '2xs': "var(--shadow-2xs)", xs: "var(--shadow-xs)", sm: "var(--shadow-sm)", DEFAULT: "var(--shadow)", md: "var(--shadow-md)", lg: "var(--shadow-lg)", xl: "var(--shadow-xl)", '2xl': "var(--shadow-2xl)", }, }, }, plugins: [require("tailwindcss-animate")], }; export default tailwindConfig;"
src/api/getUsers.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all users - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ search: z.string().optional(), roleFilter: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ users: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string().optional(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), joinedAt: z.string().optional(), lastActive: z.string().optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), })), total: z.number(), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const authorizedRoles = ['Admin', 'Owner']; if (!callerRecord?.role || !authorizedRoles.includes(callerRecord.role)) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Insufficient permissions' }); } const { records } = await Users.findAll({ limit: 500 }); let filtered = records; if (input.search) { const q = input.search.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ); } if (input.roleFilter && input.roleFilter !== 'all') { filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.role?.toLowerCase() === input.roleFilter?.toLowerCase()); } return { users: filtered.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email, firstName: u.firstName, lastName: u.lastName, role: u.role, joinedAt: u.joinedAt, lastActive: u.lastActive, isActive: u.isActive, })), total: filtered.length, }; }, }); "

content: "export interface Lesson { title: string; description: string; content: string[]; activity?: { type: 'quiz' | 'list' | 'fact'; question?: string; options?: string[]; answer?: number; items?: string[]; fact?: string; }; } export interface Subject { id: string; name: string; emoji: string; tagline: string; color: string; bgColor: string; borderColor: string; lessons: Lesson[]; } export const subjects: Subject[] = [ { id: 'reading', name: 'Reading', emoji: '📚', tagline: 'Explore stories and build comprehension skills', color: 'text-blue-700', bgColor: 'bg-blue-50', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Understanding Main Idea', description: 'Learn how to find the central point of any passage.', content: [ 'The main idea is the most important point the author wants you to understand.', 'It is often stated in the first or last sentence of a paragraph.', 'Supporting details are facts or examples that back up the main idea.', 'Ask yourself: "What is this passage mostly about?" to find the main idea.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Where is the main idea most commonly found in a paragraph?', options: ['In the middle', 'At the beginning or end', 'In every sentence', 'Only in pictures'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Making Inferences', description: 'Use clues to figure out what the author implies.', content: [ 'An inference is a conclusion you draw from evidence and reasoning.', 'Authors don\'t always state everything directly — readers must "read between the lines."', 'Combine what the text says with what you already know.', 'Example: If a character is shivering and looking for a coat, you can infer it\'s cold.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is an inference?', options: ['A direct quote from the text', 'A conclusion drawn from clues', 'The title of a book', 'A type of punctuation'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Story Elements', description: 'Identify characters, setting, plot, and theme.', content: [ 'Characters: The people or animals in the story.', 'Setting: When and where the story takes place.', 'Plot: The sequence of events (beginning, middle, end).', 'Conflict: The problem or challenge the characters face.', 'Theme: The central message or lesson of the story.', ], activity: { type: 'list', items: ['Characters', 'Setting', 'Plot', 'Conflict', 'Resolution', 'Theme'], }, }, { title: 'Figurative Language', description: 'Similes, metaphors, personification and more.', content: [ 'Simile: Comparing two things using "like" or "as" — "She runs like the wind."', 'Metaphor: Saying one thing IS another — "He is a shining star."', 'Personification: Giving human traits to non-human things — "The sun smiled down."', 'Hyperbole: Extreme exaggeration — "I\'ve told you a million times!"', 'Onomatopoeia: Words that sound like what they describe — "buzz," "crash," "sizzle."', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: '"The wind whispered through the trees." What type of figurative language is this?', options: ['Simile', 'Hyperbole', 'Personification', 'Onomatopoeia'], answer: 2, }, }, ], }, { id: 'math', name: 'Mathematics', emoji: '🔢', tagline: 'Build number sense and problem-solving skills', color: 'text-green-700', bgColor: 'bg-green-50', borderColor: 'border-green-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Fractions & Decimals', description: 'Understand parts of a whole and decimal notation.', content: [ 'A fraction represents a part of a whole: 1/2 means 1 out of 2 equal parts.', 'The top number is the numerator; the bottom is the denominator.', 'To convert a fraction to a decimal, divide the numerator by the denominator.', '1/4 = 0.25 | 1/2 = 0.50 | 3/4 = 0.75', 'Equivalent fractions have the same value: 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is 3/4 as a decimal?', options: ['0.34', '0.43', '0.75', '0.25'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Order of Operations', description: 'Learn PEMDAS to solve expressions correctly.', content: [ 'PEMDAS stands for: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication, Division, Addition, Subtraction.', 'Always solve what\'s inside parentheses first.', 'Then handle exponents (powers and roots).', 'Then multiply and divide from left to right.', 'Finally, add and subtract from left to right.', 'Example: 2 + 3 × 4 = 2 + 12 = 14 (not 20!)', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is 10 + 2 × 5?', options: ['60', '20', '25', '100'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Geometry Basics', description: 'Shapes, angles, perimeter, and area.', content: [ 'Perimeter: The total distance around a shape. P = sum of all sides.', 'Area of a rectangle: A = length × width.', 'Area of a triangle: A = ½ × base × height.', 'A right angle measures 90°. An acute angle is less than 90°. An obtuse angle is more than 90°.', 'Pi (π ≈ 3.14) is used to find the circumference and area of circles.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is the area of a rectangle with length 6 and width 4?', options: ['10', '20', '24', '48'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Algebra Fundamentals', description: 'Solve for unknowns using equations.', content: [ 'A variable is a letter that represents an unknown number (e.g., x, y, n).', 'An equation states that two expressions are equal: 3x + 2 = 11.', 'To solve for x, use inverse operations (undo what was done).', '3x + 2 = 11 → subtract 2 → 3x = 9 → divide by 3 → x = 3.', 'Always do the same operation to both sides of the equation.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Solve: 2x + 4 = 12. What is x?', options: ['3', '4', '6', '8'], answer: 1, }, }, ], }, { id: 'science', name: 'Science', emoji: '🔬', tagline: 'Discover the wonders of the natural world', color: 'text-purple-700', bgColor: 'bg-purple-50', borderColor: 'border-purple-200', lessons: [ { title: 'The Scientific Method', description: 'Learn the steps scientists use to investigate.', content: [ '1. Observation: Notice something interesting in the world around you.', '2. Question: Ask a specific, testable question about your observation.', '3. Hypothesis: Make an educated guess (prediction) about the answer.', '4. Experiment: Design and conduct a controlled test.', '5. Data: Record your measurements and observations carefully.', '6. Conclusion: Analyze results and determine if your hypothesis was correct.', ], activity: { type: 'list', items: ['Observation', 'Question', 'Hypothesis', 'Experiment', 'Data Collection', 'Conclusion'], }, }, { title: 'Cells: The Building Blocks of Life', description: 'Explore plant and animal cells.', content: [ 'All living things are made of cells — the smallest unit of life.', 'Animal cells have a cell membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, and mitochondria.', 'Plant cells also have a cell wall, chloroplasts, and a large central vacuole.', 'The nucleus is the "control center" containing DNA.', 'Mitochondria produce energy through cellular respiration.', 'Chloroplasts in plant cells capture sunlight for photosynthesis.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Which organelle is known as the "powerhouse of the cell"?', options: ['Nucleus', 'Chloroplast', 'Mitochondria', 'Cell Wall'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'The Solar System', description: 'Explore our sun, planets, and beyond.', content: [ 'Our solar system has 8 planets orbiting the Sun.', 'Inner planets (rocky): Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.', 'Outer planets (gas giants): Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.', 'Earth is the only known planet with liquid water on the surface.', 'Jupiter is the largest planet; Mercury is the smallest.', 'A light-year is the distance light travels in one year (~5.88 trillion miles).', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'How many planets are in our solar system?', options: ['7', '8', '9', '10'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'States of Matter', description: 'Solid, liquid, gas, and plasma.', content: [ 'Solid: Particles are tightly packed, definite shape and volume.', 'Liquid: Particles flow freely, definite volume but no definite shape.', 'Gas: Particles spread out to fill any container, no definite shape or volume.', 'Plasma: A high-energy state found in stars like our Sun.', 'Changes of state: melting (solid→liquid), freezing (liquid→solid), evaporation (liquid→gas), condensation (gas→liquid).', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What happens to water at 100°C (212°F) at sea level?', options: ['It freezes', 'It turns to plasma', 'It boils and evaporates', 'It stays liquid'], answer: 2, }, }, ], }, { id: 'social-studies', name: 'Social Studies', emoji: '🌍', tagline: 'Understand people, places, and societies', color: 'text-orange-700', bgColor: 'bg-orange-50', borderColor: 'border-orange-200', lessons: [ { title: 'World Geography', description: 'Continents, oceans, and how to read maps.', content: [ 'There are 7 continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, South America.', 'There are 5 major oceans: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, Arctic.', 'Latitude lines run east-west and measure distance from the equator.', 'Longitude lines run north-south and measure distance from the Prime Meridian.', 'A map scale helps us measure real distances on a map.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'How many continents are there on Earth?', options: ['5', '6', '7', '8'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Types of Government', description: 'Democracy, monarchy, and more.', content: [ 'Democracy: Citizens vote to elect leaders and make decisions.', 'Monarchy: A king or queen holds power, either absolute or constitutional.', 'Republic: Citizens elect representatives who make decisions on their behalf.', 'Dictatorship: A single ruler holds all power, often by force.', 'The United States is a constitutional democratic republic.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'In which type of government do citizens vote to elect their leaders?', options: ['Monarchy', 'Dictatorship', 'Democracy', 'Theocracy'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'World Cultures', description: 'Explore diversity and traditions globally.', content: [ 'Culture includes language, food, art, religion, customs, and values.', 'Over 7,000 languages are spoken around the world today.', 'Religion plays a major role in culture: Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism are among the most widely practiced.', 'Cultural diffusion is the spread of ideas, customs, and culture between societies.', 'Respecting cultural differences promotes global understanding and peace.', ], activity: { type: 'fact', fact: 'Over 7,000 different languages are spoken around the world — and many are at risk of disappearing!', }, }, { title: 'Economics Basics', description: 'Supply, demand, and how economies work.', content: [ 'Economics is the study of how people make choices about scarce resources.', 'Supply: How much of a product is available to buy.', 'Demand: How much of a product people want to buy.', 'When demand is high and supply is low, prices tend to rise.', 'Trade allows countries to exchange goods and services they produce efficiently.', 'GDP (Gross Domestic Product) measures the total value of goods/services produced.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'When demand is high and supply is low, what usually happens to prices?', options: ['Prices fall', 'Prices stay the same', 'Prices rise', 'Prices disappear'], answer: 2, }, }, ], }, { id: 'language-arts', name: 'Language Arts', emoji: '✍️', tagline: 'Write, speak, and communicate with confidence', color: 'text-pink-700', bgColor: 'bg-pink-50', borderColor: 'border-pink-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Parts of Speech', description: 'Nouns, verbs, adjectives, and more.', content: [ 'Noun: A person, place, thing, or idea. (dog, city, freedom)', 'Verb: An action or state of being. (run, is, think)', 'Adjective: Describes a noun. (tall, blue, happy)', 'Adverb: Describes a verb, adjective, or another adverb. (quickly, very)', 'Pronoun: Replaces a noun. (he, she, they, it)', 'Conjunction: Connects words or clauses. (and, but, or, because)', 'Preposition: Shows relationship between words. (in, on, under, beside)', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'In the sentence "The quick brown fox jumps," what part of speech is "quick"?', options: ['Noun', 'Verb', 'Adjective', 'Adverb'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Essay Writing', description: 'Structure strong introductions, bodies, and conclusions.', content: [ 'Introduction: Hook the reader, provide background, end with a thesis statement.', 'Thesis statement: The main argument or point of your essay.', 'Body paragraphs: Each starts with a topic sentence, followed by evidence and analysis.', 'Conclusion: Restate the thesis, summarize key points, end with a closing thought.', 'Use transition words (however, furthermore, in contrast) to connect ideas smoothly.', ], activity: { type: 'list', items: ['Hook/Attention Grabber', 'Background Information', 'Thesis Statement', 'Body Paragraph 1', 'Body Paragraph 2', 'Body Paragraph 3', 'Conclusion'], }, }, { title: 'Punctuation Rules', description: 'Commas, apostrophes, colons, and semicolons.', content: [ 'Comma: Separates items in a list, joins independent clauses with conjunctions, sets off introductory phrases.', 'Apostrophe: Used for contractions (can\'t, it\'s) and possession (Sarah\'s book).', 'Semicolon: Connects two closely related independent clauses.', 'Colon: Introduces a list, quotation, or explanation.', 'Quotation marks: Enclose direct speech or titles of short works.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Which punctuation mark connects two closely related independent clauses?', options: ['Comma', 'Semicolon', 'Apostrophe', 'Colon'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Vocabulary Building', description: 'Prefixes, suffixes, and root words.', content: [ 'Root word: The base word that carries the main meaning. (port = carry)', 'Prefix: Added to the beginning to change meaning. (un-, re-, pre-, mis-)', 'Suffix: Added to the end to change meaning or function. (-tion, -ful, -less, -er)', '"pre" + "view" = preview (to see before)', '"un" + "happy" = unhappy (not happy)', '"teach" + "er" = teacher (one who teaches)', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What does the prefix "un-" usually mean?', options: ['Again', 'Before', 'Not', 'After'], answer: 2, }, }, ], }, { id: 'history', name: 'History', emoji: '🏛️', tagline: 'Discover the events that shaped our world', color: 'text-yellow-700', bgColor: 'bg-yellow-50', borderColor: 'border-yellow-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Ancient Civilizations', description: 'Egypt, Mesopotamia, Greece, and Rome.', content: [ 'Mesopotamia (modern Iraq) was one of the earliest civilizations, around 3500 BCE.', 'Ancient Egyptians built the pyramids and developed hieroglyphic writing.', 'Ancient Greece gave us democracy, philosophy, and the Olympic Games.', 'The Roman Empire stretched from Britain to the Middle East at its peak.', 'These civilizations developed writing, law, mathematics, and art.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Which ancient civilization is known for inventing democracy?', options: ['Egypt', 'Mesopotamia', 'Greece', 'Rome'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'The American Revolution', description: 'How the United States became independent.', content: [ 'The 13 American colonies declared independence from Britain on July 4, 1776.', 'Key causes: taxation without representation, British control, and Enlightenment ideas.', 'The Declaration of Independence was written primarily by Thomas Jefferson.', 'General George Washington led the Continental Army.', 'The Treaty of Paris (1783) officially ended the war and recognized U.S. independence.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'When did the United States declare independence?', options: ['1765', '1776', '1783', '1800'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'World War II', description: 'The global conflict from 1939 to 1945.', content: [ 'WWII began in 1939 when Germany invaded Poland.', 'The Allied Powers (US, UK, Soviet Union, France) fought the Axis Powers (Germany, Italy, Japan).', 'The Holocaust: Nazi Germany systematically murdered 6 million Jewish people.', 'The US entered the war after the attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.', 'The war ended in Europe on May 8, 1945 (V-E Day) and in the Pacific on August 15, 1945 (V-J Day).', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What event brought the her bus seat in 1955, sparking the Montgomery Bus Boycott.', 'Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. led nonviolent protests and delivered the "I Have a Dream" speech in 1963.', 'The Civil Rights Act of 1964 banned discrimination based on race, color, religion, or national origin.', 'The Voting Rights Act of 1965 prohibited discriminatory voting practices.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What 'Notes, rhythm, scales, and melody.', content: [ 'Music is made up of notes: A, B, C, D, E, F, G (and sharps/flats).', 'A scale is a set of notes arranged by pitch. The C major scale uses only white keys on a piano.', 'Rhythm is the pattern of sounds over time; measured in beats.', 'A melody is a sequence of notes that forms a recognizable tune.', 'Harmony is when multiple notes are played together to create chords.', 'Tempo is the speed of a piece: slow (adagio), medium (andante), fast (allegro).', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is the tempo term for a fast piece of music?', options: ['Adagio', 'Andante', 'Allegro', 'Forte'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Music Genres', description: 'Classical, jazz, rock, and world music.', content: [ 'Classical: Orchestral music composed by masters like Beethoven, Mozart, and Bach.', 'Jazz: Developed by African Americans in the early 1900s; features improvisation and syncopation.', 'Blues: Originated in the American South; expressive vocals and guitar with a 12-bar structure.', 'Rock & Roll: Grew from blues in the 1950s; popularized by Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.', 'Hip-Hop: Emerged in 1970s New York; includes rapping, DJing, breakdancing, and graffiti art.', ], activity: { type: 'fact', fact: 'Jazz is often called "America\'s classical music" and was one of the first truly original American art forms!', }, }, ], }, { id: 'stem', name: 'STEM & Technology', emoji: '💻', tagline: 'Code, engineer, and solve real-world problems', color: 'text-teal-700', bgColor: 'bg-teal-50', borderColor: 'border-teal-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Introduction to Coding', description: 'Learn how computers follow instructions.', content: [ 'A computer program is a set of instructions written in a programming language.', 'Popular languages: Python (great for beginners), JavaScript (for websites), Java, C++.', 'Variables store data: age = 12 means the variable "age" holds the value 12.', 'Loops repeat actions: a "for loop" runs a block of code a set number of times.', 'Conditions: "if/else" statements let programs make decisions.', 'Functions are reusable blocks of code that perform a specific task.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Which programming language is often recommended for beginners?', options: ['Assembly', 'Python', 'C++', 'Machine Code'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Engineering Design Process', description: 'How engineers solve problems step by step.', content: [ '1. src/api/checkAdmin.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Check the current user role and permissions', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ role: z.string(), isOwner: z.boolean(), isAdmin: z.boolean(), isModerator: z.boolean(), canManageUsers: z.boolean(), canManageAdmins: z.boolean(), canManageSite: z.boolean(), canManageHub: z.boolean(), canViewAuditLog: z.boolean(), user: z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), }), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const record = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const role = record?.role ?? 'User'; const isOwner = role === 'Owner'; const isAdmin = role === 'Admin' || isOwner; const isModerator = role === 'Moderator' || isAdmin; return { role, isOwner, isAdmin, isModerator, canManageUsers: isModerator, canManageAdmins: isOwner, canManageSite: isAdmin, canManageHub: isAdmin, canViewAuditLog: isModerator, user: { id: context.user.id, email: context.user.email, firstName: context.user.firstName, lastName: context.user.lastName, role, }, }; }, }); "
src/api/deleteUser.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, AuditLog, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; function roleRank(role?: string): number { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; case 'Banned': return 0; default: return 1; } } export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Delete a user — enforces role hierarchy', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string() }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const [caller, target] = await Promise.all([ Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }), Users.findOne({ id: input.userId }), ]); const callerRank = roleRank(caller?.role); const targetRank = roleRank(target?.role); if (callerRank < 3) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Only Admins and Owners can delete users' }); if (input.userId === context.user.id) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Cannot delete your own account' }); if (targetRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot delete a user with equal or higher rank' }); await AuditLog.create({ record: { action: `Deleted user`, performedBy: context.user.email, targetUser: target?.email ?? input.userId, details: `${caller?.role} ${context.user.email} deleted user ${target?.email}`, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), roleLevel: caller?.role ?? 'Admin', }, }); await Users.delete({ id: input.userId }); return { success: true }; }, }); "
src/api/getHubTabs.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubTabs, HubItems } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; const itemSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), itemName: z.string().optional(), url: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), }); const tabSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), tabName: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), tabType: z.string().optional(), sortOrder: z.number().optional(), items: z.array(itemSchema), }); export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all hub tabs with their items (public)', inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ tabs: z.array(tabSchema) }), execute: async () => { const [{ records: tabs }, { records: items }] = await Promise.all([ HubTabs.findAll({ limit: 100 }), HubItems.findAll({ limit: 500 }), ]); const sorted = [...tabs].sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder ?? 0) - (b.sortOrder ?? 0)); return { tabs: sorted.map(t => ({ id: t.id, tabName: t.tabName, emoji: t.emoji, tabType: t.tabType, sortOrder: t.sortOrder, items: items .filter(i => i.tabId === t.id) .map(i => ({ id: i.id, itemName: i.itemName, url: i.url, emoji: i.emoji, description: i.description })), })), }; }, }); "
src/api/updateUser.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, AuditLog, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; function roleRank(role?: string): number { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; case 'Banned': return 0; default: return 1; } } export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a user role or status — enforces role hierarchy', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string(), role: z.enum(['Owner', 'Admin', 'Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']).optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const [caller, target] = await Promise.all([ Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }), Users.findOne({ id: input.userId }), ]); const callerRank = roleRank(caller?.role); const targetRank = roleRank(target?.role); const newRank = input.role ? roleRank(input.role) : targetRank; // Must be at least Moderator if (callerRank < 2) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Insufficient permissions' }); // Cannot modify yourself if (input.userId === context.user.id) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Cannot modify your own account' }); // Cannot target someone of equal or higher rank if (targetRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot modify a user with equal or higher rank' }); // Cannot assign a role equal to or higher than your own if (newRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot assign a role equal to or higher than yours' }); // Moderators can only ban/unban regular users if (callerRank === 2 && input.role && !['User', 'Banned'].includes(input.role)) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Moderators can only change users to User or Banned' }); } const updates: Partial<{ role: string; isActive: boolean }> = {}; if (input.role !== undefined) updates.role = input.role; if (input.isActive !== undefined) updates.isActive = input.isActive; await Users.update({ id: input.userId, record: updates }); // Log the action await AuditLog.create({ record: { action: input.role ? `Changed role to ${input.role}` : `Updated active status to ${input.isActive}`, performedBy: context.user.email, targetUser: target?.email ?? input.userId, details: `${caller?.role} ${context.user.email} updated user ${target?.email}`, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), roleLevel: caller?.role ?? 'User', }, }); return { success: true }; }, }); "
src/api/getAuditLog.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, AuditLog, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get audit log entries — moderator+ only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ limit: z.number().optional() }), outputSchema: z.object({ entries: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), action: z.string().optional(), performedBy: z.string().optional(), targetUser: z.string().optional(), details: z.string().optional(), timestamp: z.string().optional(), roleLevel: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const rank = caller?.role === 'Owner' ? 4 : caller?.role === 'Admin' ? 3 : caller?.role === 'Moderator' ? 2 : 0; if (rank < 2) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Moderator+ required' }); const { records } = await AuditLog.findAll({ limit: input.limit ?? 100 }); const sorted = [...records].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp ?? 0).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp ?? 0).getTime() ); return { entries: sorted.map(e => ({ id: e.id, action: e.action, performedBy: e.performedBy, targetUser: e.targetUser, details: e.details, timestamp: e.timestamp, roleLevel: e.roleLevel, })), }; }, }); "
src/api/manageHubTab.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubTabs, HubItems, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete a hub tab — admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), tabName: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), tabType: z.enum(['Single', 'Multiple']).optional(), sortOrder: z.number().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (caller?.role !== 'Admin') throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin only' }); if (input.action === 'create') { const rec = await HubTabs.create({ record: { tabName: input.tabName, emoji: input.emoji, tabType: input.tabType ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: input.sortOrder ?? 0 }, }); return { success: true, id: rec.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await HubTabs.update({ id: input.id, record: { tabName: input.tabName, emoji: input.emoji, tabType: input.tabType, sortOrder: input.sortOrder } }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { // Delete all items belonging to this tab first const { records: items } = await HubItems.findAll({ filters: { tabId: input.id } }); await Promise.all(items.map(i => HubItems.delete({ id: i.id }))); await HubTabs.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "

src/api/manageHubItem.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubItems, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete a hub item — admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), tabId: z.string().optional(), itemName: z.string().optional(), url: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const allowedRoles = ['Owner', 'Admin', 'Moderator']; if (!caller?.role || !allowedRoles.includes(caller.role)) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin only' }); if (input.action === 'create') { const rec = await HubItems.create({ record: { itemName: input.itemName, url: input.url, emoji: input.emoji, description: input.description, tabId: input.tabId }, }); return { success: true, id: rec.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await HubItems.update({ id: input.id, record: { itemName: input.itemName, url: input.url, emoji: input.emoji, description: input.description } }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { await HubItems.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "
src/components/Navbar.tsx:
content: "import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; import { GraduationCap, LogIn, LogOut } from 'lucide-react'; import { useAuth } from 'zite-auth-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; export default function Navbar() { const location = useLocation(); const { user, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, logout } = useAuth(); return ( <nav className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-b border-border"> <div className="container mx-auto px-4 h-16 flex items-center justify-between"> <Link to="/" className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-xl text-primary"> <GraduationCap className="w-7 h-7" /> <span>EduWorld</span> </Link> <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> {location.pathname !== '/' && ( <Link to="/" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"> ← All Subjects </Link> )} {!isLoading && ( user ? ( <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block"> {user.firstName ?? user.email} </span> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => logout()} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"> <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" /> <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sign Out</span> </Button> </div> ) : ( <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-1.5"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sign In</span> </Button> ) )} </div> </div> </nav> ); } "
src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx:
content: "import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { subjects } from '../data/subjects'; import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { useAuth } from 'zite-auth-sdk'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Lightbulb, List, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; export default function SubjectPage() { const { user, isLoading, loginWithRedirect } = useAuth(); const { id } = useParams(); useEffect(() => { if (!isLoading && !user) { loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href }); } }, [isLoading, user]); if (isLoading || !user) return null; const subject = subjects.find((s) => s.id === id); const [openLesson, setOpenLesson] = useState<number | null>(0); if (!subject) { return ( <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center"> <div className="text-6xl mb-4">🔍</div> <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Subject not found</h2> <Link to="/" className="text-primary hover:underline">Go back home</Link> </div> ); } return ( <div className="min-h-screen"> {/* Header */} <div className={`${subject.bgColor} border-b ${subject.borderColor} py-12 px-4`}> <div className="container mx-auto max-w-3xl"> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}> <div className="text-6xl mb-3">{subject.emoji}</div> <h1 className={`text-4xl font-extrabold ${subject.color} mb-2`}>{subject.name}</h1> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-lg mb-4">{subject.tagline}</p> <Badge variant="secondary">{subject.lessons.length} Lessons</Badge> </motion.div> </div> </div> {/* Lessons */} <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-10 max-w-3xl"> <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground mb-6">📖 Lessons</h2> <div className="space-y-4"> {subject.lessons.map((lesson, idx) => ( <motion.div key={idx} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: idx * 0.07 }} className={`border-2 ${subject.borderColor} rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-card shadow-sm`} > <button className="w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors" onClick={() => setOpenLesson(openLesson === idx ? null : idx)} > <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <span className={`font-bold text-lg w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm ${subject.bgColor} ${subject.color} border ${subject.borderColor}`}> {idx + 1} </span> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">{lesson.title}</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{lesson.description}</div> </div> </div> {openLesson === idx ? ( <ChevronUp className={`w-5 h-5 ${subject.color} shrink-0`} /> ) : ( <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" /> )} </button> <AnimatePresence initial={false}> {openLesson === idx && ( <motion.div initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25 }} > <div className={`px-6 pb-6 pt-2 border-t ${subject.borderColor} bg-background`}> {/* Content */} <ul className="space-y-2 mb-6"> {lesson.content.map((point, i) => ( <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/90"> <span className={`mt-1 shrink-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${subject.bgColor} border ${subject.borderColor}`} /> <span>{point}</span> </li> ))} </ul> {/* Activity */} {lesson.activity && ( <ActivityBlock activity={lesson.activity} subjectColor={subject.color} subjectBg={subject.bgColor} subjectBorder={subject.borderColor} /> )} </div> </motion.div> )} </AnimatePresence> </motion.div> ))} </div> <div className="mt-10 text-center"> <Link to="/"> <Button variant="outline">← Back to All Subjects</Button> </Link> </div> </div> </div> ); } interface ActivityProps { activity: NonNullable<import('../data/subjects').Lesson['activity']>; subjectColor: string; subjectBg: string; subjectBorder: string; } function ActivityBlock({ activity, subjectColor, subjectBg, subjectBorder }: ActivityProps) { const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null); const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false); if (activity.type === 'fact') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4 flex items-start gap-3`}> <Lightbulb className={`w-5 h-5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${subjectColor}`} /> <div> <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground mb-1">Fun Fact</div> <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{activity.fact}</p> </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'list') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <List className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Key Terms</span> </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {activity.items?.map((item, i) => ( <span key={i} className={`text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full border ${subjectBorder} bg-background font-medium ${subjectColor}`}> {item} </span> ))} </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'quiz') { const isCorrect = selected === activity.answer; return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <HelpCircle className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Quick Quiz</span> </div> <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-3">{activity.question}</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {activity.options?.map((opt, i) => { const isSelected = selected === i; const showResult = selected !== null; const isAnswerKey = i === activity.answer; let btnClass = 'border-border bg-background text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50'; if (showResult && isSelected && isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; if (showResult && isSelected && !isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-red-400 bg-red-50 text-red-800'; if (showResult && !isSelected && isAnswerKey) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; return ( <button key={i} disabled={selected !== null} onClick={() => setSelected(i)} className={`w-full text-left text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border-2 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between ${btnClass}`} > <span>{opt}</span> {showResult && isAnswerKey && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />} {showResult && isSelected && !isCorrect && i === selected && <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />} </button> ); })} </div> {selected !== null && ( <motion.p initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className={`mt-3 text-sm font-medium ${isCorrect ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-red-700'}`} > {isCorrect ? '🎉 Correct! Great job!' : `❌ Not quite. The correct answer is: "${activity.options?.[activity.answer ?? 0]}"`} </motion.p> )} {selected !== null && ( <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="mt-2 text-xs" onClick={() => { setSelected(null); setRevealed(false); }} > Try Again </Button> )} {revealed && <span className="hidden">{revealed}</span>} </div> ); } return null; } "
src/api/getSiteSettings.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, SiteSettings, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all site settings - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ settings: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), settingKey: z.string().optional(), settingValue: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await SiteSettings.findAll({}); return { settings: records.map(s => ({ id: s.id, settingKey: s.settingKey, settingValue: s.settingValue, description: s.description, })), }; }, }); "
src/api/getAnnouncements.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Announcements, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all announcements - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ announcements: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string().optional(), message: z.string().optional(), status: z.string().optional(), postedAt: z.string().optional(), postedBy: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const role = callerRecord?.role ?? 'User'; const isAdmin = role === 'Admin' || role === 'Owner'; if (!isAdmin) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await Announcements.findAll({ limit: 100 }); return { announcements: records.map(a => ({ id: a.id, title: a.title, message: a.message, status: a.status, postedAt: a.postedAt, postedBy: a.postedBy, })), }; }, }); "
src/api/updateSiteSetting.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, SiteSettings, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a site setting - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ key: z.string(), value: z.string(), description: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const existing = await SiteSettings.findOne({ filters: { settingKey: input.key } }); if (existing) { await SiteSettings.update({ id: existing.id, record: { settingValue: input.value } }); } else { await SiteSettings.create({ record: { settingKey: input.key, settingValue: input.value, description: input.description ?? '' }, }); } return { success: true }; }, }); "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { X, Gamepad2, Globe, Shield, Zap, LogIn, Users, Megaphone, Settings, BarChart3, Layers, RefreshCw, Monitor, Maximize2, ExternalLink, Crown, ShieldCheck, ClipboardList } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { useAuth } from 'zite-auth-sdk'; import { checkAdmin, getHubTabs, GetHubTabsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import UserManager from './admin/UserManager'; import AnnouncementManager from './admin/AnnouncementManager'; import SiteControls from './admin/SiteControls'; import TabManager from './admin/TabManager'; import AuditLogViewer from './admin/AuditLogViewer'; import HubTabContent from './HubTabContent'; import IframeViewer, { openCloaked } from './IframeViewer'; import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner'; import { GAMES, PROXIES } from '@/data/hubData'; type HubTab = GetHubTabsOutputType['tabs'][0]; type AdminSubTab = 'overview' | 'users' | 'announcements' | 'tabs' | 'settings' | 'audit'; const ROLE_META: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = { Owner: { label: 'OWNER', color: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30', icon: <Crown className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Admin: { label: 'ADMIN', color: 'bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border border-destructive/30', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Moderator: { label: 'MOD', color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> }, }; export default function SecretHub({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) { const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('games'); const { user, isLoading, loginWithRedirect } = useAuth(); const [roleInfo, setRoleInfo] = useState<any>(null); const [adminChecked, setAdminChecked] = useState(false); const [adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab] = useState<AdminSubTab>('overview'); const [customTabs, setCustomTabs] = useState<HubTab[]>([]); const [tabsLoading, setTabsLoading] = useState(true); const [iframeTarget, setIframeTarget] = useState<{ url: string; name: string; emoji?: string } | null>(null); useEffect(() => { if (!isLoading && user) { checkAdmin({}).then(res => { setRoleInfo(res); setAdminChecked(true); }).catch(() => setAdminChecked(true)); } else if (!isLoading) { setAdminChecked(true); } }, [user, isLoading]); const loadCustomTabs = async () => { setTabsLoading(true); try { const res = await getHubTabs({}); setCustomTabs(res.tabs); } catch {} setTabsLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { loadCustomTabs(); }, []); const builtInTabs = [ { id: 'games', label: 'Games', icon: Gamepad2, emoji: null }, { id: 'proxies', label: 'Proxies', icon: Globe, emoji: null }, ]; const allDisplayTabs = [ ...builtInTabs, ...customTabs.map(t => ({ id: `custom_${t.id}`, label: t.tabName ?? 'Tab', icon: null, emoji: t.emoji })), ]; const activeCustomTab = activeTab.startsWith('custom_') ? customTabs.find(t => `custom_${t.id}` === activeTab) : null; const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo?.role ?? '']; return ( <> <Toaster /> {iframeTarget && ( <IframeViewer url={iframeTarget.url} title={iframeTarget.name} emoji={iframeTarget.emoji} onClose={() => setIframeTarget(null)} /> )} <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4"> <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }} animate={{ scale: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }} className="bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl"> {/* Header */} <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border bg-muted/30 shrink-0"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" /> <span className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">Genizy Hub</span> <span className="text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">SECRET</span> {roleMeta && ( <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium flex items-center gap-1 ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon}{roleMeta.label} </span> )} </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground" title="Refresh" onClick={loadCustomTabs}> <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${tabsLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> {user && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block">{user.email}</span>} <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button> </div> </div> {/* Tab Bar */} <div className="flex border-b border-border overflow-x-auto shrink-0"> {allDisplayTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(t.id)} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${activeTab === t.id ? 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> {t.icon ? <t.icon className="w-4 h-4" /> : <span className="text-sm">{(t as any).emoji || '📋'}</span>} {t.label} </button> ))} <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('admin')} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ml-auto ${activeTab === 'admin' ? 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <Shield className="w-4 h-4" /> Admin {roleInfo?.isModerator && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-destructive" />} </button> </div> {/* Content */} <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={activeTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {activeTab === 'games' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">{GAMES.length} games — hover to launch</p> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3"> {GAMES.map((g, i) => <LaunchCard key={i} name={g.name} url={g.url} emoji={g.emoji} desc={g.desc} onIframe={() => setIframeTarget({ url: g.url, name: g.name, emoji: g.emoji })} />)} </div> </div> )} {activeTab === 'proxies' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">{PROXIES.length} proxies — choose how to launch</p> <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3"> {PROXIES.map((p, i) => <LaunchCard key={i} name={p.name} url={p.url} emoji={p.emoji} desc={p.desc} onIframe={() => setIframeTarget({ url: p.url, name: p.name, emoji: p.emoji })} wide />)} </div> </div> )} {activeCustomTab && <HubTabContent tab={activeCustomTab} />} {activeTab === 'admin' && ( <AdminSection user={user} roleInfo={roleInfo} adminChecked={adminChecked} isLoading={isLoading} loginWithRedirect={loginWithRedirect} adminSubTab={adminSubTab} setAdminSubTab={setAdminSubTab} /> )} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> </motion.div> </motion.div> </> ); } function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className={`relative rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${wide ? 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; adminSubTab: AdminSubTab; setAdminSubTab: (t: AdminSubTab) => void; }) { if (isLoading || !adminChecked) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" /> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Checking access...</p> </div> ); } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } "
src/api/manageAnnouncement.ts:
content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Announcements, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete an announcement - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), title: z.string().optional(), message: z.string().optional(), status: z.enum(['Active', 'Draft', 'Archived']).optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } if (input.action === 'create') { const record = await Announcements.create({ record: { title: input.title, message: input.message, status: input.status ?? 'Draft', postedAt: new Date().toISOString(), postedBy: context.user.email, }, }); return { success: true, id: record.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await Announcements.update({ id: input.id, record: { title: input.title, message: input.message, status: input.status }, }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { await Announcements.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "
src/components/IframeViewer.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useRef } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { X, Maximize2, Minimize2, ExternalLink, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; interface Props { url: string; title: string; emoji?: string; onClose: () => void; } export function openCloaked(url: string, title: string) { const w = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); if (!w) return; w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${title}</title><style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}html,body,iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;overflow:hidden}</style></head><body><iframe src="${url}" allowfullscreen allow="autoplay; fullscreen"></iframe></body></html>`); w.document.close(); } export default function IframeViewer({ url, title, emoji, onClose }: Props) { const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false); const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const toggleFullscreen = () => { if (!isFullscreen) { containerRef.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } else { document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } setIsFullscreen(!isFullscreen); }; return ( <motion.div ref={containerRef} initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] bg-black flex flex-col" > {/* Toolbar */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-card border-b border-border shrink-0"> <button onClick={onClose} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors text-sm"> <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back </button> <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"> {emoji && <span>{emoji}</span>} <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate max-w-xs">{title}</span> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title="Open cloaked in new tab" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, title)} > <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title={isFullscreen ? 'Exit fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen'} onClick={toggleFullscreen} > {isFullscreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />} </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={onClose}> <X className="w-4 h-4" /> </Button> </div> </div> {/* Iframe */} <iframe src={url} className="flex-1 w-full border-none" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; accelerometer; gyroscope" allowFullScreen title={title} /> </motion.div> ); } "
