content: "import { useState } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { ExternalLink, Maximize2, Monitor } from 'lucide-react'; import IframeViewer, { openCloaked } from './IframeViewer'; import { GetHubTabsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; type HubTab = GetHubTabsOutputType['tabs'][0]; type HubItem = HubTab['items'][0]; interface Props { tab: HubTab; } export default function HubTabContent({ tab }: Props) { const [iframeItem, setIframeItem] = useState<HubItem | null>(null); if (iframeItem) { return ( <IframeViewer url={iframeItem.url ?? ''} title={iframeItem.itemName ?? ''} emoji={iframeItem.emoji ?? undefined} onClose={() => setIframeItem(null)} /> ); } // Single item — auto-show as iframe with action buttons if (tab.tabType === 'Single' && tab.items.length > 0) { const item = tab.items[0]; return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-64 gap-6 py-8"> <div className="text-6xl">{item.emoji || tab.emoji || '🌐'}</div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1">{item.itemName}</div> {item.description && <div className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{item.description}</div>} </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center"> <ActionBtn icon={<Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Open as iframe" onClick={() => setIframeItem(item)} primary /> <ActionBtn icon={<ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Cloaked new tab" onClick={() => openCloaked(item.url ?? '', item.itemName ?? '')} /> <ActionBtn icon={<Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Fullscreen iframe" onClick={() => { setIframeItem(item); }} /> </div> </div> ); } // Multiple items — gaming/modern grid return ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-5"> {tab.items.length} item{tab.items.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · Click a card to open </p> {tab.items.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-14 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No items yet</div> ) : ( <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4"> {tab.items.map((item, i) => ( <motion.div key={item.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} > <MultiItemCard item={item} onIframe={() => setIframeItem(item)} /> </motion.div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); } function MultiItemCard({ item, onIframe }: { item: HubItem; onIframe: () => void }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className="relative group rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5" > {/* Glow effect */} <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> <div className="relative p-5"> <div className="text-4xl mb-3">{item.emoji || '🌐'}</div> <div className="font-bold text-foreground mb-0.5 text-base">{item.itemName}</div> {item.description && ( <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{item.description}</div> )} {/* Action row */} <div className={`flex gap-2 transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-60 translate-y-1'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(item.url ?? '', item.itemName ?? '')} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </div> ); } function ActionBtn({ icon, label, onClick, primary }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void; primary?: boolean }) { return ( <button onClick={onClick} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150 border ${ primary ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground border-primary hover:opacity-90' : 'bg-muted/40 text-foreground border-border hover:bg-primary/10 hover:border-primary/40' }`} > {icon} {label} </button> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors" > {icon} {label} </button> ); } "
src/components/admin/TabManager.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getHubTabs, manageHubTab, manageHubItem, GetHubTabsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Plus, Trash2, Pencil, ChevronRight, ArrowLeft, Check, Layers, Link } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; type HubTab = GetHubTabsOutputType['tabs'][0]; type HubItem = HubTab['items'][0]; type View = 'tabs' | 'items' | 'editTab' | 'editItem'; export default function TabManager() { const [tabs, setTabs] = useState<HubTab[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [view, setView] = useState<View>('tabs'); const [selectedTab, setSelectedTab] = useState<HubTab | null>(null); const [editingTab, setEditingTab] = useState<Partial<HubTab> | null>(null); const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<Partial<HubItem & { tabId?: string }> | null>(null); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<{ type: 'tab' | 'item'; id: string; name: string } | null>(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getHubTabs({}); setTabs(res.tabs); if (selectedTab) { const updated = res.tabs.find(t => t.id === selectedTab.id); if (updated) setSelectedTab(updated); } } catch { toast.error('Failed to load tabs'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // Save tab const saveTab = async () => { if (!editingTab?.tabName?.trim()) { toast.error('Tab name required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editingTab.id) { await manageHubTab({ action: 'update', id: editingTab.id, tabName: editingTab.tabName, emoji: editingTab.emoji ?? '', tabType: (editingTab.tabType as 'Single' | 'Multiple') ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: editingTab.sortOrder ?? 0 }); toast.success('Tab updated'); } else { await manageHubTab({ action: 'create', tabName: editingTab.tabName, emoji: editingTab.emoji ?? '', tabType: (editingTab.tabType as 'Single' | 'Multiple') ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: editingTab.sortOrder ?? 0 }); toast.success('Tab created'); } await load(); setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setSaving(false); }; // Save item const saveItem = async () => { if (!editingItem?.itemName?.trim()) { toast.error('Item name required'); return; } if (!editingItem?.url?.trim()) { toast.error('URL required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editingItem.id) { await manageHubItem({ action: 'update', id: editingItem.id, itemName: editingItem.itemName, url: editingItem.url, emoji: editingItem.emoji ?? '', description: editingItem.description ?? '' }); toast.success('Item updated'); } else { await manageHubItem({ action: 'create', tabId: selectedTab?.id, itemName: editingItem.itemName, url: editingItem.url, emoji: editingItem.emoji ?? '', description: editingItem.description ?? '' }); toast.success('Item added'); } await load(); setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setSaving(false); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { if (deleteTarget.type === 'tab') { await manageHubTab({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); setSelectedTab(null); setView('tabs'); toast.success('Tab deleted'); } else { await manageHubItem({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); toast.success('Item deleted'); } await load(); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to delete'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const renderTabList = () => ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{tabs.length} custom tab{tabs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingTab({ tabType: 'Multiple', sortOrder: tabs.length }); setView('editTab'); }}> <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> New Tab </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : tabs.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No custom tabs yet. Create one to get started.</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {tabs.map(tab => ( <div key={tab.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3 group"> <span className="text-xl">{tab.emoji || '📋'}</span> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{tab.tabName}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{tab.tabType} · {tab.items?.length ?? 0} item{(tab.items?.length ?? 0) !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs gap-1" onClick={() => { setSelectedTab(tab); setView('items'); }}> Items <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => { setEditingTab(tab); setView('editTab'); }}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget({ type: 'tab', id: tab.id, name: tab.tabName ?? '' })}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); const renderItemList = () => ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setView('tabs')}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{selectedTab?.emoji} {selectedTab?.tabName}</span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-muted border border-border">{selectedTab?.tabType}</span> </div> <div className="flex justify-end"> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingItem({}); setView('editItem'); }}> <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Add Item </Button> </div> {(selectedTab?.items?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No items yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {selectedTab?.items?.map(item => ( <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <span className="text-lg">{item.emoji || '🔗'}</span> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{item.itemName}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{item.url}</div> </div> <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => { setEditingItem(item); setView('editItem'); }}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget({ type: 'item', id: item.id, name: item.itemName ?? '' })}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); const renderEditTab = () => ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); }}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editingTab?.id ? 'Edit Tab' : 'New Tab'}</span> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2"> <Input placeholder="Emoji" value={editingTab?.emoji ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, emoji: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-1" /> <Input placeholder="Tab name" value={editingTab?.tabName ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, tabName: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-3" /> </div> <div className="space-y-1"> <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Tab Type</label> <Select value={editingTab?.tabType ?? 'Multiple'} onValueChange={v => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, tabType: v }))}> <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="Multiple">Multiple Items — grid layout</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Single">Single Item — direct launch</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-1"> {editingTab?.tabType === 'Single' ? 'Only the first item is used. It opens directly with iframe/fullscreen/cloaked options.' : 'All items shown as a gaming-style grid. Each card has its own launch options.'} </p> </div> <Input placeholder="Sort order (0 = first)" type="number" value={editingTab?.sortOrder ?? 0} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, sortOrder: Number(e.target.value) }))} /> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={saveTab} disabled={saving}><Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Tab'}</Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); }}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); const renderEditItem = () => ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); }}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editingItem?.id ? 'Edit Item' : 'New Item'}</span> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2"> <Input placeholder="Emoji" value={editingItem?.emoji ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, emoji: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-1" /> <Input placeholder="Item name" value={editingItem?.itemName ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, itemName: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-3" /> </div> <div className="relative"> <Link className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="https://example.com" value={editingItem?.url ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, url: e.target.value }))} className="pl-8" /> </div> <Input placeholder="Short description (optional)" value={editingItem?.description ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, description: e.target.value }))} /> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={saveItem} disabled={saving}><Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Item'}</Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); }}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); return ( <div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"> <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Custom Hub Tabs</span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">— visible to all hub visitors</span> </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={view} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {view === 'tabs' && renderTabList()} {view === 'items' && renderItemList()} {view === 'editTab' && renderEditTab()} {view === 'editItem' && renderEditItem()} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete {deleteTarget?.type === 'tab' ? 'Tab' : 'Item'}</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription> Permanently delete "<strong>{deleteTarget?.name}</strong>"? {deleteTarget?.type === 'tab' && ' All items in this tab will also be deleted.'} </AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "
src/components/admin/UserManager.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getUsers, GetUsersOutputType, updateUser, deleteUser } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Search, Trash2, ShieldCheck, UserX, RefreshCw, Crown, Shield, User, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type UserRow = GetUsersOutputType['users'][0]; type RoleName = 'Owner' | 'Admin' | 'Moderator' | 'User' | 'Banned'; const ROLE_META: Record<string, { color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = { Owner: { color: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30', icon: <Crown className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Admin: { color: 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Moderator: { color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> }, User: { color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border', icon: <User className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Banned: { color: 'bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border-destructive/30', icon: <UserX className="w-3 h-3" /> }, }; function roleRank(role?: string) { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; default: return 0; } } function getAssignableRoles(myRole?: string): RoleName[] { switch (myRole) { case 'Owner': return ['Owner', 'Admin', 'Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Admin': return ['Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Moderator': return ['User', 'Banned']; default: return []; } } export default function UserManager({ myRole }: { myRole?: string }) { const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all'); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<UserRow | null>(null); const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async (s = search, r = roleFilter) => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getUsers({ search: s, roleFilter: r }); setUsers(res.users); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load users'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, role: RoleName) => { setUpdating(userId); try { await updateUser({ userId, role }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === userId ? { ...u, role } : u)); toast.success('Role updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleToggleActive = async (user: UserRow) => { setUpdating(user.id); try { await updateUser({ userId: user.id, isActive: !user.isActive }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === user.id ? { ...u, isActive: !u.isActive } : u)); toast.success('Status updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await deleteUser({ userId: deleteTarget.id }); setUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('User deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const assignableRoles = getAssignableRoles(myRole); const canDelete = roleRank(myRole) >= 3; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> {/* Permission hint */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-border"> {myRole === 'Owner' && <><Crown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" /> Owner — full user management, including admins</>} {myRole === 'Admin' && <><Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> Admin — manage Moderators and below</>} {myRole === 'Moderator' && <><ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" /> Moderator — can ban/unban regular users only</>} </div> <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2"> <div className="relative flex-1"> <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="Search users..." className="pl-9" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); load(e.target.value, roleFilter); }} /> </div> <Select value={roleFilter} onValueChange={v => { setRoleFilter(v); load(search, v); }}> <SelectTrigger className="w-36"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="all">All Roles</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Owner">Owner</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Admin">Admin</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Moderator">Moderator</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="User">User</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Banned">Banned</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => load()}><RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /></Button> </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{users.length} user{users.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : users.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No users found</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {users.map(user => { const meta = ROLE_META[user.role ?? 'User'] ?? ROLE_META.User; const targetRank = roleRank(user.role); const myRank = roleRank(myRole); const canModify = targetRank < myRank; return ( <div key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"> {meta.icon} </div> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate"> {user.firstName || user.lastName ? `${user.firstName ?? ''} ${user.lastName ?? ''}`.trim() : user.email} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{user.email}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium flex items-center gap-1 ${meta.color}`}> {meta.icon}{user.role ?? 'User'} </span> {canModify && assignableRoles.length > 0 && ( <Select value={user.role ?? 'User'} onValueChange={v => handleRoleChange(user.id, v as RoleName)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <SelectTrigger className="h-7 w-28 text-xs"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> {assignableRoles.map(r => <SelectItem key={r} value={r}>{r}</SelectItem>)} </SelectContent> </Select> )} {canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => handleToggleActive(user)} disabled={updating === user.id} title={user.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}> {user.isActive !== false ? <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> : <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />} </Button> )} {canDelete && canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(user)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> )} </div> </div> ); })} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete User</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Permanently delete <strong>{deleteTarget?.email}</strong>? This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "
src/components/admin/SiteControls.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getSiteSettings, updateSiteSetting } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import { Settings, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'; const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = [ { key: 'maintenance_mode', label: 'Maintenance Mode', description: 'Show a maintenance page to all visitors', default: 'false' }, { key: 'new_registrations', label: 'New Registrations', description: 'Allow new users to sign up', default: 'true' }, { key: 'game_access', label: 'Game Access', description: 'Allow users to access the games hub', default: 'true' }, { key: 'proxy_access', label: 'Proxy Access', description: 'Allow users to access the proxy hub', default: 'true' }, { key: 'show_announcements', label: 'Show Announcements', description: 'Display active announcements to users', default: 'true' }, ]; export default function SiteControls() { const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({}); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [saving, setSaving] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getSiteSettings({}); const map: Record<string, string> = {}; for (const s of res.settings) { if (s.settingKey) map[s.settingKey] = s.settingValue ?? ''; } setValues(map); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load settings'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const toggle = async (key: string, currentValue: string) => { const newVal = currentValue === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'; setSaving(key); try { await updateSiteSetting({ key, value: newVal }); setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: newVal })); toast.success('Setting updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to update'); } setSaving(null); }; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"> <Settings className="w-4 h-4" /> Site-wide toggles </div> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={load} className="h-7 w-7"> <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-3">{[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2"> {DEFAULT_SETTINGS.map(setting => { const val = values[setting.key] ?? setting.default; const isOn = val === 'true'; const isSaving = saving === setting.key; return ( <div key={setting.key} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-3"> <div> <div className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{setting.label}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{setting.description}</div> </div> <button onClick={() => toggle(setting.key, val)} disabled={isSaving} className={`relative inline-flex items-center w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none ${isOn ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-border'} ${isSaving ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`} > <span className={`inline-block w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full shadow transition-transform ${isOn ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'}`} /> </button> </div> ); })} </div> )} </div> ); } "
src/components/admin/AuditLogViewer.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getAuditLog, GetAuditLogOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { RefreshCw, Crown, Shield, ShieldCheck, ClipboardList } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type Entry = GetAuditLogOutputType['entries'][0]; const ROLE_ICON: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = { Owner: <Crown className="w-3 h-3 text-yellow-400" />, Admin: <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" />, Moderator: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />, }; function formatDate(iso?: string) { if (!iso) return '—'; return new Date(iso).toLocaleString(); } export default function AuditLogViewer() { const [entries, setEntries] = useState<Entry[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getAuditLog({ limit: 100 }); setEntries(res.entries); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load audit log'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); return ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex items-center justify-between"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"> <ClipboardList className="w-4 h-4" /> {entries.length} log entries </div> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={load}> <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-12 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : entries.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No audit log entries yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {entries.map(entry => ( <div key={entry.id} className="bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5"> <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-foreground"> {ROLE_ICON[entry.roleLevel ?? ''] ?? null} {entry.performedBy} </span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">→</span> <span className="text-xs text-foreground/70">{entry.targetUser}</span> </div> <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">{entry.action}</div> {entry.details && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 truncate">{entry.details}</div>} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">{formatDate(entry.timestamp)}</div> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); } "
src/components/admin/AnnouncementManager.tsx:
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getAnnouncements, manageAnnouncement, GetAnnouncementsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Plus, Trash2, Pencil, Megaphone, Check } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type Ann = GetAnnouncementsOutputType['announcements'][0]; const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = { Active: 'text-green-400 bg-green-400/10 border-green-400/20', Draft: 'text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-400/10 border-yellow-400/20', Archived: 'text-muted-foreground bg-muted/40 border-border', }; export default function AnnouncementManager() { const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<Ann[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Partial<Ann> | null>(null); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<Ann | null>(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getAnnouncements({}); setAnnouncements(res.announcements); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load announcements'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleSave = async () => { if (!editing?.title?.trim()) { toast.error('Title is required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editing.id) { await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'update', id: editing.id, title: editing.title, message: editing.message ?? '', status: (editing.status as any) ?? 'Draft' }); setAnnouncements(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === editing.id ? { ...a, ...editing } : a)); toast.success('Announcement updated'); } else { const res = await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'create', title: editing.title, message: editing.message ?? '', status: (editing.status as any) ?? 'Draft' }); await load(); toast.success('Announcement created'); } setEditing(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to save'); } setSaving(false); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); setAnnouncements(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('Deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to delete'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; if (editing !== null) { return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>← Back</Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editing.id ? 'Edit Announcement' : 'New Announcement'}</span> </div> <Input placeholder="Title" value={editing.title ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, title: e.target.value }))} /> <textarea className="w-full bg-background border border-border rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-foreground resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 h-28" placeholder="Message..." value={editing.message ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, message: e.target.value }))} /> <Select value={editing.status ?? 'Draft'} onValueChange={v => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, status: v }))}> <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="Active">Active</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Draft">Draft</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Archived">Archived</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'} </Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); } return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{announcements.length} announcement{announcements.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing({ status: 'Draft' })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> New </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-16 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : announcements.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No announcements yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {announcements.map(ann => ( <div key={ann.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4 text-primary mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{ann.title}</div> {ann.message && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate mt-0.5">{ann.message}</div>} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${STATUS_COLORS[ann.status ?? 'Draft'] ?? STATUS_COLORS.Draft}`}> {ann.status ?? 'Draft'} </span> {ann.postedBy && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">by {ann.postedBy}</span>} </div> </div> <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => setEditing(ann)}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(ann)}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Announcement</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Delete "<strong>{deleteTarget?.title}</strong>"? This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "

nonDevSummary: "Your **EduWorld** educational site is live and packed with content across 8 subjects! <list icon="book">Reading, Math, Science, Social Studies, Language Arts, History, Art & Music, and STEM & Tech — each with multiple topics to explore</list> <list icon="check-circle">Every lesson includes a quiz with instant right/wrong feedback and a retry option</list> <list icon="zap">Fun facts and key terms are highlighted throughout to make learning more engaging</list>"
 "Now let me build the full educational site!The **EduWorld** educational site is ready! Here's what was built: ### 🎓 What's Included **8 Full Subjects:** - 📚 **Reading** — Main idea, inferences, story elements, figurative language - 🔢 **Mathematics** — Fractions, order of operations, geometry, algebra - 🔬 **Science** — Scientific method, cells, solar system, states of matter - 🌍 **Social Studies** — World geography, government types, cultures, economics - ✍️ **Language Arts** — Parts of speech, essay writing, punctuation, vocabulary - 🏛️ **History** — Ancient civilizations, American Revolution, WWII, Civil Rights - 🎨 **Art & Music** — Elements of art, famous artists, music theory, genres - 💻 **STEM & Tech** — Coding, engineering design, internet safety, physics **Interactive Features per Lesson:** - 📖 Expandable accordion-style lesson cards - ✅ Multiple-choice quizzes with instant feedback (correct/incorrect highlighting) - 💡 Fun fact callouts - 🏷️ Key terms badges - 🔄 "Try Again" button to retry quizzes"

content: "export interface Lesson { title: string; description: string; content: string[]; activity?: { type: 'quiz' | 'list' | 'fact'; question?: string; options?: string[]; answer?: number; items?: string[]; fact?: string; }; } export interface Subject { id: string; name: string; emoji: string; tagline: string; color: string; bgColor: string; borderColor: string; lessons: Lesson[]; } export const subjects: Subject[] = [ { id: 'reading', name: 'Reading', emoji: '📚', tagline: 'Explore stories and build comprehension skills', color: 'text-blue-700', bgColor: 'bg-blue-50', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Understanding Main Idea', description: 'Learn how to find the central point of any passage.', content: [ 'The main idea is the most important point the author wants you to understand.', 'It is often stated in the first or last sentence of a paragraph.', 'Supporting details are facts or examples that back up the main idea.', 'Ask yourself: "What is this passage mostly about?" to find the main idea.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Where is the main idea most commonly found in a paragraph?', options: ['In the middle', 'At the beginning or end', 'In every sentence', 'Only in pictures'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Making Inferences', description: 'Use clues to figure out what the author implies.', content: [ 'An inference is a conclusion you draw from evidence and reasoning.', 'Authors don\'t always state everything directly — readers must "read between the lines."', 'Combine what the text says with what you already know.', 'Example: If a character is shivering and looking for a coat, you can infer it\'s cold.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is an inference?', options: ['A direct quote from the text', 'A conclusion drawn from clues', 'The title of a book', 'A type of punctuation'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Story Elements', description: 'Identify characters, setting, plot, and theme.', content: [ 'Characters: The people or animals in the story.', 'Setting: When and where the story takes place.', 'Plot: The sequence of events (beginning, middle, end).', 'Conflict: The problem or challenge the characters face.', 'Theme: The central message or lesson of the story.', ], activity: { type: 'list', items: ['Characters', 'Setting', 'Plot', 'Conflict', 'Resolution', 'Theme'], }, }, { title: 'Figurative Language', description: 'Similes, metaphors, personification and more.', content: [ 'Simile: Comparing two things using "like" or "as" — "She runs like the wind."', 'Metaphor: Saying one thing IS another — "He is a shining star."', 'Personification: Giving human traits to non-human things — "The sun smiled down."', 'Hyperbole: Extreme exaggeration — "I\'ve told you a million times!"', 'Onomatopoeia: Words that sound like what they describe — "buzz," "crash," "sizzle."', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: '"The wind whispered through the trees." What type of figurative language is this?', options: ['Simile', 'Hyperbole', 'Personification', 'Onomatopoeia'], answer: 2, }, }, ], }, { id: 'math', name: 'Mathematics', emoji: '🔢', tagline: 'Build number sense and problem-solving skills', color: 'text-green-700', bgColor: 'bg-green-50', borderColor: 'border-green-200', lessons: [ { title: 'Fractions & Decimals', description: 'Understand parts of a whole and decimal notation.', content: [ 'A fraction represents a part of a whole: 1/2 means 1 out of 2 equal parts.', 'The top number is the numerator; the bottom is the denominator.', 'To convert a fraction to a decimal, divide the numerator by the denominator.', '1/4 = 0.25 | 1/2 = 0.50 | 3/4 = 0.75', 'Equivalent fractions have the same value: 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is 3/4 as a decimal?', options: ['0.34', '0.43', '0.75', '0.25'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Order of Operations', description: 'Learn PEMDAS to solve expressions correctly.', content: [ 'PEMDAS stands for: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication, Division, Addition, Subtraction.', 'Always solve what\'s inside parentheses first.', 'Then handle exponents (powers and roots).', 'Then multiply and divide from left to right.', 'Finally, add and subtract from left to right.', 'Example: 2 + 3 × 4 = 2 + 12 = 14 (not 20!)', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is 10 + 2 × 5?', options: ['60', '20', '25', '100'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'Geometry Basics', description: 'Shapes, angles, perimeter, and area.', content: [ 'Perimeter: The total distance around a shape. P = sum of all sides.', 'Area of a rectangle: A = length × width.', 'Area of a triangle: A = ½ × base × height.', 'A right angle measures 90°. An acute angle is less than 90°. An obtuse angle is more than 90°.', 'Pi (π ≈ 3.14) is used to find the circumference and area of circles.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'What is the area of a rectangle with length 6 and width 4?', options: ['10', '20', '24', '48'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'Algebra Fundamentals', description: 'Solve for unknowns using equations.', content: [ 'A variable is a letter that represents an unknown number (e.g., x, y, n).', 'An equation states that two expressions are equal: 3x + 2 = 11.', 'To solve for x, use inverse operations (undo what was done).', '3x + 2 = 11 → subtract 2 → 3x = 9 → divide by 3 → x = 3.', 'Always do the same operation to both sides of the equation.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Solve: 2x + 4 = 12. What is x?', options: ['3', '4', '6', '8'], answer: 1, }, }, ], }, { id: 'science', name: 'Science', emoji: '🔬', tagline: 'Discover the wonders of the natural world', color: 'text-purple-700', bgColor: 'bg-purple-50', borderColor: 'border-purple-200', lessons: [ { title: 'The Scientific Method', description: 'Learn the steps scientists use to investigate.', content: [ '1. Observation: Notice something interesting in the world around you.', '2. Question: Ask a specific, testable question about your observation.', '3. Hypothesis: Make an educated guess (prediction) about the answer.', '4. Experiment: Design and conduct a controlled test.', '5. Data: Record your measurements and observations carefully.', '6. Conclusion: Analyze results and determine if your hypothesis was correct.', ], activity: { type: 'list', items: ['Observation', 'Question', 'Hypothesis', 'Experiment', 'Data Collection', 'Conclusion'], }, }, { title: 'Cells: The Building Blocks of Life', description: 'Explore plant and animal cells.', content: [ 'All living things are made of cells — the smallest unit of life.', 'Animal cells have a cell membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, and mitochondria.', 'Plant cells also have a cell wall, chloroplasts, and a large central vacuole.', 'The nucleus is the "control center" containing DNA.', 'Mitochondria produce energy through cellular respiration.', 'Chloroplasts in plant cells capture sunlight for photosynthesis.', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Which organelle is known as the "powerhouse of the cell"?', options: ['Nucleus', 'Chloroplast', 'Mitochondria', 'Cell Wall'], answer: 2, }, }, { title: 'The Solar System', description: 'Explore our sun, planets, and beyond.', content: [ 'Our solar system has 8 planets orbiting the Sun.', 'Inner planets (rocky): Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.', 'Outer planets (gas giants): Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.', 'Earth is the only known planet with liquid water on the surface.', 'Jupiter is the largest planet; Mercury is the smallest.', 'A light-year is the distance light travels in one year (~5.88 trillion miles).', ], activity: { type: 'quiz', question: 'How many planets are in our solar system?', options: ['7', '8', '9', '10'], answer: 1, }, }, { title: 'States of Matter', description: content: "import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { subjects } from '../data/subjects'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { ChevronRight, Star, BookOpen, Users } from 'lucide-react'; export default function Home() { return ( <div> {/* Hero */} <section className="relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/10 via-background to-secondary/10 py-20 px-4"> <div className="container mx-auto text-center max-w-3xl"> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}> <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm font-medium mb-6"> <Star className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" /> Free Learning for Everyone </div> <h1 className="text-5xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold text-foreground mb-4 leading-tight"> Learn Anything,<br /> <span className="text-primary">Anytime.</span> </h1> <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground mb-8 max-w-xl mx-auto"> Explore interactive lessons across 8 subjects. Build skills, earn confidence, and discover the joy of learning. </p> <div className="flex justify-center gap-8 mb-2"> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">8</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Subjects</div> </div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">32+</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Lessons</div> </div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">100%</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Free</div> </div> </div> </motion.div> </div> </section> {/* Subjects Grid */} <section className="container mx-auto px-4 py-16"> <div className="text-center mb-12"> <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">Choose a Subject</h2> <p className="text-muted-foreground">Click any subject to start learning</p> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"> {subjects.map((subject, i) => ( <motion.div key={subject.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.07 }} > <Link to={`/subject/${subject.id}`}> <div className={`group rounded-2xl border-2 ${subject.borderColor} ${subject.bgColor} p-6 h-full hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 cursor-pointer`}> <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{subject.emoji}</div> <h3 className={`text-xl font-bold mb-1 ${subject.color}`}>{subject.name}</h3> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{subject.tagline}</p> <div className="flex items-center justify-between"> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"> <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3" /> {subject.lessons.length} lessons </span> <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 ${subject.color} group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform`} /> </div> </div> </Link> </motion.div> ))} </div> </section> {/* Footer Banner */} <section className="bg-primary/5 border-t border-border py-12 px-4 mt-8"> <div className="container mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 max-w-4xl"> <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" /> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">Built for Curious Learners</div> <div content: "import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { subjects } from '../data/subjects'; import { useState } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Lightbulb, List, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; export default function SubjectPage() { const { id } = useParams(); const subject = subjects.find((s) => s.id === id); const [openLesson, setOpenLesson] = useState<number | null>(0); if (!subject) { return ( <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center"> <div className="text-6xl mb-4">🔍</div> <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Subject not found</h2> <Link to="/" className="text-primary hover:underline">Go back home</Link> </div> ); } return ( <div className="min-h-screen"> {/* Header */} <div className={`${subject.bgColor} border-b ${subject.borderColor} py-12 px-4`}> <div className="container mx-auto max-w-3xl"> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}> <div className="text-6xl mb-3">{subject.emoji}</div> <h1 className={`text-4xl font-extrabold ${subject.color} mb-2`}>{subject.name}</h1> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-lg mb-4">{subject.tagline}</p> <Badge variant="secondary">{subject.lessons.length} Lessons</Badge> </motion.div> </div> </div> {/* Lessons */} <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-10 max-w-3xl"> <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground mb-6">📖 Lessons</h2> <div className="space-y-4"> {subject.lessons.map((lesson, idx) => ( <motion.div key={idx} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: idx * 0.07 }} className={`border-2 ${subject.borderColor} rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-card shadow-sm`} > <button className="w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors" onClick={() => setOpenLesson(openLesson === idx ? null : idx)} > <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <span className={`font-bold text-lg w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm ${subject.bgColor} ${subject.color} border ${subject.borderColor}`}> {idx + 1} </span> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">{lesson.title}</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{lesson.description}</div> </div> </div> {openLesson === idx ? ( <ChevronUp className={`w-5 h-5 ${subject.color} shrink-0`} /> ) : ( <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" /> )} </button> <AnimatePresence initial={false}> {openLesson === idx && ( <motion.div initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25 }} > <div className={`px-6 pb-6 pt-2 border-t ${subject.borderColor} bg-background`}> {/* Content */} <ul className="space-y-2 mb-6"> {lesson.content.map((point, i) => ( <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/90"> <span className={`mt-1 shrink-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${subject.bgColor} border ${subject.borderColor}`} /> <span>{point}</span> </li> ))} </ul> {/* Activity */} {lesson.activity && ( <ActivityBlock activity={lesson.activity} subjectColor={subject.color} subjectBg={subject.bgColor} subjectBorder={subject.borderColor} /> )} </div> </motion.div> )} </AnimatePresence> </motion.div> ))} </div> <div className="mt-10 text-center"> <Link to="/"> <Button variant="outline">← Back to All Subjects</Button> </Link> </div> </div> </div> ); } interface ActivityProps { activity: NonNullable<import('../data/subjects').Lesson['activity']>; subjectColor: string; subjectBg: string; subjectBorder: string; } function ActivityBlock({ activity, subjectColor, subjectBg, subjectBorder }: ActivityProps) { const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null); const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false); if (activity.type === 'fact') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4 flex items-start gap-3`}> <Lightbulb className={`w-5 h-5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${subjectColor}`} /> <div> <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground mb-1">Fun Fact</div> <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{activity.fact}</p> </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'list') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <List className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Key Terms</span> </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {activity.items?.map((item, i) => ( <span key={i} className={`text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full border ${subjectBorder} bg-background font-medium ${subjectColor}`}> {item} </span> ))} </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'quiz') { const isCorrect = selected === activity.answer; return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <HelpCircle className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Quick Quiz</span> </div> <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-3">{activity.question}</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {activity.options?.map((opt, i) => { const isSelected = selected === i; const showResult = selected !== null; const isAnswerKey = i === activity.answer; let btnClass = 'border-border bg-background text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50'; if (showResult && isSelected && isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; if (showResult && isSelected && !isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-red-400 bg-red-50 text-red-800'; if (showResult && !isSelected && isAnswerKey) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; text-foreground">8</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Subjects</div> </div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">32+</div> <div text-muted-foreground">Free</div> </div> </div> </motion.div> </div> </section> {/* Subjects Grid */} <section className="container mx-auto px-4 py-16"> <div className="text-center mb-12"> <h2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"> {subjects.map((subject, i) => ( <motion.div key={subject.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.07 }} > <Link to={`/subject/${subject.id}`}> <div className={`group rounded-2xl border-2 ${subject.borderColor} ${subject.bgColor} p-6 h-full hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 cursor-pointer`}> <div className="text-5xl mb-4">{subject.emoji}</div> <h3 className={`text-xl font-bold mb-1 ${subject.color}`}>{subject.name}</h3> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4 "create" "import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { subjects } from '../data/subjects'; import { useState } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Lightbulb, List, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; export default function SubjectPage() { const { id } = useParams(); const subject = subjects.find((s) => s.id === id); const [openLesson, setOpenLesson] = useState<number | null>(0); if (!subject) { return ( <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center"> <div className="text-6xl mb-4">🔍</div> <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Subject not found</h2> <Link to="/" className="text-primary hover:underline">Go back home</Link> </div> ); } return ( <div className="min-h-screen"> {/* Header */} <div className={`${subject.bgColor} border-b ${subject.borderColor} py-12 px-4`}> <div className="container mx-auto max-w-3xl"> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}> <div className="text-6xl mb-3">{subject.emoji}</div> <h1 className={`text-4xl font-extrabold ${subject.color} mb-2`}>{subject.name}</h1> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-lg mb-4">{subject.tagline}</p> <Badge variant="secondary">{subject.lessons.length} Lessons</Badge> </motion.div> </div> </div> {/* Lessons */} <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-10 max-w-3xl"> <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground mb-6">📖 Lessons</h2> <div className="space-y-4"> {subject.lessons.map((lesson, idx) => ( <motion.div key={idx} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: idx * 0.07 }} className={`border-2 ${subject.borderColor} rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-card shadow-sm`} > <button className="w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors" onClick={() => setOpenLesson(openLesson === idx ? null : idx)} > <div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <span className={`font-bold text-lg w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm ${subject.bgColor} ${subject.color} border ${subject.borderColor}`}> {idx + 1} </span> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">{lesson.title}</div> <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{lesson.description}</div> </div> </div> {openLesson === idx ? ( <ChevronUp className={`w-5 h-5 ${subject.color} shrink-0`} /> ) : ( <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" /> )} </button> <AnimatePresence initial={false}> {openLesson === idx && ( <motion.div initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25 }} > <div className={`px-6 pb-6 pt-2 border-t ${subject.borderColor} bg-background`}> {/* Content */} <ul className="space-y-2 mb-6"> {lesson.content.map((point, i) => ( <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/90"> <span className={`mt-1 shrink-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${subject.bgColor} border ${subject.borderColor}`} /> <span>{point}</span> </li> ))} </ul> {/* Activity */} {lesson.activity && ( <ActivityBlock activity={lesson.activity} subjectColor={subject.color} subjectBg={subject.bgColor} subjectBorder={subject.borderColor} /> )} </div> </motion.div> )} </AnimatePresence> </motion.div> ))} </div> <div className="mt-10 text-center"> <Link to="/"> <Button variant="outline">← Back to All Subjects</Button> </Link> </div> </div> </div> ); } interface ActivityProps { activity: NonNullable<import('../data/subjects').Lesson['activity']>; subjectColor: string; subjectBg: string; subjectBorder: string; } function ActivityBlock({ activity, subjectColor, subjectBg, subjectBorder }: ActivityProps) { const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null); const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false); if (activity.type === 'fact') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4 flex items-start gap-3`}> <Lightbulb className={`w-5 h-5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${subjectColor}`} /> <div> <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground mb-1">Fun Fact</div> <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{activity.fact}</p> </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'list') { return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <List className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Key Terms</span> </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {activity.items?.map((item, i) => ( <span key={i} className={`text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full border ${subjectBorder} bg-background font-medium ${subjectColor}`}> {item} </span> ))} </div> </div> ); } if (activity.type === 'quiz') { const isCorrect = selected === activity.answer; return ( <div className={`rounded-xl ${subjectBg} border ${subjectBorder} p-4`}> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"> <HelpCircle className={`w-4 h-4 ${subjectColor}`} /> <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Quick Quiz</span> </div> <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-3">{activity.question}</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {activity.options?.map((opt, i) => { const isSelected = selected === i; const showResult = selected !== null; const isAnswerKey = i === activity.answer; let btnClass = 'border-border bg-background text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50'; if (showResult && isSelected && isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; if (showResult && isSelected && !isCorrect) btnClass = 'border-red-400 bg-red-50 text-red-800'; if (showResult && !isSelected && isAnswerKey) btnClass = 'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-800'; return ( <button key={i} disabled={selected !== null} onClick={() => setSelected(i)} className={`w-full text-left text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border-2 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between ${btnClass}`} > <span>{opt}</span> {showResult && isAnswerKey && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />} {showResult && isSelected && !isCorrect && i === selected && <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />} </button> ); })} </div> {selected !== null && ( <motion.p initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className={`mt-3 text-sm font-medium ${isCorrect ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-red-700'}`} > {isCorrect ? '🎉 Correct! Great job!' : `❌ Not quite. The correct answer is: "${activity.options?.[activity.answer ?? 0]}"`} </motion.p> )} {selected !== null && ( <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="mt-2 text-xs" onClick={() => { setSelected(null); setRevealed(false); }} > Try Again </Button> )} {revealed && <span className="hidden">{revealed}</span>} </div> ); } return null; } " "src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx"

nonDevSummary: "I've built out a full admin system for your site! Here's what's ready: <list icon="lock">Admin access is role-based — only accounts marked as "Admin" in your database can get in. Everyone else sees either a sign-in prompt or an access denied message.</list> <list icon="users">A Users tab lets you search, filter, change roles, ban users, or delete them entirely.</list> <list icon="megaphone">An Announcements tab lets you create and manage announcements with draft, active, or archived status.</list> <list icon="settings">A Site Controls tab gives you toggle switches for things like maintenance mode, new registrations, and game access.</list> <list icon="chart">An Overview tab shows a quick summary of your site's stats.</list> To give yourself admin access, go to the **Database tab** in the Zite editor, find your account in the Users table, and set your Role to `Admin` — then the full panel will unlock for you automatically."
 "Now I'll build all the backend endpoints and the full admin panel:Now build the full admin panel UI and update the secret hub:Now rebuild `SecretHub` to use real auth-based admin access:Now update the Navbar to add a login/logout button:Here's everything that was built: --- ### 🔐 How Admin Access Works - **No password required** — the admin panel checks if your **logged-in account has the Admin role** in the database - If not signed in → shows a **Sign In** button - If signed in but not admin → shows **Access Denied** - If signed in as admin → full panel unlocks instantly ✅ ### 👑 Admin Panel (4 tabs inside the Hub) 1. **Overview** — Site stats at a glance 2. **Users** — Full user manager: - Search & filter by role - Change any user's role (Admin / User / Banned) via dropdown - Toggle active/inactive status - Delete users with confirmation dialog 3. **Announcements** — Create, edit, and delete announcements with Active/Draft/Archived status 4. **Site Controls** — Toggle switches for: Maintenance Mode, New Registrations, Game Access, Proxy Access, Show Announcements ### 🏁 To Make Yourself an Admin Go to the **Database tab** in the Zite editor → **Users** table → find your user record → set the **Role** field to `Admin`. Next time you open the hub, you'll have full access."

Full control of the site I need to set up authentication so admins can log in. I'll need a database to store users with admin roles, and use the auth system. Let me think about the approach: - Use Zite's auth system (external mode with login) - Database with users table that has a role field (admin/user) - Admin panel in the secret hub - but only accessible if the logged-in user is an admin - Remove the password from the admin tab, replace with auth check - Create a Users table with email, role, and name fields, then sync logged-in users to the database - Build backend endpoints to verify admin status and handle user management - Update SecretHub to check admin privileges instead of password - The admin panel will include user management tools, site controls like maintenance mode, announcements, and stats" "reasoning"

sdk: "// Base SDK exports - always available /** Filter operators for querying records (Prisma-style) */ type FilterOperators<T> = { not?: T; in?: T[]; notIn?: T[]; lt?: number | Date; lte?: number | Date; gt?: number | Date; gte?: number | Date; contains?: any; } | T; /** Filter type for record queries - use field names as keys with FilterOperators or direct values for equality */ type RecordFilters<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: FilterOperators<T[K]> }; /** Helper type to infer schema output type */ type InferSchemaType<T> = T extends { _output: infer U } ? U : T; /** Stream interface for streaming endpoints */ type ZiteStreamInterface = { /** Write a chunk to the stream (sent to frontend in real-time) */ write: (data: any) => Promise<void>; /** Forward an AsyncIterable to the stream and collect the result */ forward: (asyncIterable: AsyncIterable<string>) => Promise<string>; }; /** Error class for endpoint errors with typed error codes */ type ZiteErrorCode = 'BAD_REQUEST' | 'UNAUTHORIZED' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND' | 'CONFLICT' | 'RATE_LIMITED' | 'INTERNAL_ERROR'; declare class ZiteError extends Error { code: ZiteErrorCode; /** Create a ZiteError with a code and message */ constructor(options: { code: ZiteErrorCode; message: string }); } /** Context type for endpoint execute functions */ type ZiteRequestContext = { user: { id: string; // The user's unique record ID. IMPORTANT: Use this value when you need to link records to the current user (e.g., for 'createdBy' or 'owner' linked record fields). email: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string; role?: "Admin" | "User" | "Banned" | string; joinedAt?: string; lastActive?: string; isActive?: boolean; }; }; /** Create a typed streaming endpoint (stream is always available when stream: true) */ declare function createEndpoint<TInput, TOutput>(config: { /** Optional unique identifier for the endpoint */ id?: string; /** Description of what this endpoint does */ description?: string; /** Whether this endpoint requires authentication (only applies when auth is enabled) */ authenticated?: boolean; /** Enable streaming — the stream parameter will be available in execute */ stream: true; /** Zod schema for input validation */ inputSchema: TInput; /** Zod schema for output validation */ outputSchema: TOutput; /** The endpoint implementation */ execute: (params: { input: InferSchemaType<TInput>; context: ZiteRequestContext; /** Streaming interface — use stream.forward() or stream.write() to send chunks */ stream: ZiteStreamInterface; }) => Promise<InferSchemaType<TOutput>>; }): { inputSchema: TInput; outputSchema: TOutput; }; /** Create a typed backend endpoint */ declare function createEndpoint<TInput, TOutput>(config: { /** Optional unique identifier for the endpoint */ id?: string; /** Description of what this endpoint does */ description?: string; /** Whether this endpoint requires authentication (only applies when auth is enabled) */ authenticated?: boolean; stream?: false; /** Zod schema for input validation */ inputSchema: TInput; /** Zod schema for output validation */ outputSchema: TOutput; /** The endpoint implementation */ execute: (params: { input: InferSchemaType<TInput>; context: ZiteRequestContext; }) => Promise<InferSchemaType<TOutput>>; }): { inputSchema: TInput; outputSchema: TOutput; }; export { ZiteError, createEndpoint }; // ------------------ // Zite Database SDK v1.0.0 // Defines the typescript classes/functions to interact with the tables in this base. // The SDK class and field names are stable identifiers that don't change when renamed. Each table and field has a comment with its current user-facing name in quotes (e.g., // "Task Name"). // Important: The quoted name reflects the most up-to-date name and meaning of the field. // If the SDK name differs from the quoted name, it means the field was renamed. The quoted name is the source of truth for the meaning of the field. // Fields may include display configuration in their comments. Values from the database are raw (e.g. ISO strings for dates); your app should format them for display according to these configs. // LINKED RECORDS: Fields marked "Links to X table" reference records in table X. Values must be UUID record IDs (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33") from findOne/findAll - never use fake IDs. // AI FIELDS: Fields marked "(AI field)" have values automatically generated by AI. They do not compute instantly and may populate after a delay. /** * Some helpful tips when using this SDK: * - IMPORTANT: Rate limit is up to 50 requests per second per base. * - To avoid hitting rate limits: * - Use bulkCreate() instead of calling create() in a loop * - Use findAll() with filters/pagination instead of calling findOne() repeatedly in a loop * - Keep large data operations paginated and chunked rather than one-record-at-a-time * - If handling many requests, add retry logic for 429 responses */ /** * Type definition for a record in the "Users" table */ export type UsersRecordType = { email?: string; // Primary field, "Email" firstName?: string; // "First Name" lastName?: string; // "Last Name" role?: "Admin" | "User" | "Banned" | string; // "Role" joinedAt?: string; // "Joined At", Date and time field. Value is an ISO string; display to user as "local" date (e.g. 2/8/2026) with 12h time (2:30 PM) lastActive?: string; // "Last Active" isActive?: boolean; // "Is Active" id: string; // Unique UUID identifier for this record (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33"). Use this value when linking records. }; /** * Type definition for a record in the "Announcements" table */ export type AnnouncementsRecordType = { title?: string; // Primary field, "Title" message?: string; // "Message" status?: "Active" | "Draft" | "Archived" | string; // "Status" postedAt?: string; // "Posted At", Date and time field. Value is an ISO string; display to user as "local" date (e.g. 2/8/2026) with 12h time (2:30 PM) postedBy?: string; // "Posted By" id: string; // Unique UUID identifier for this record (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33"). Use this value when linking records. }; /** * Type definition for a record in the "Site Settings" table */ export type SiteSettingsRecordType = { settingKey?: string; // Primary field, "Setting Key" settingValue?: string; // "Setting Value" description?: string; // "Description" id: string; // Unique UUID identifier for this record (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33"). Use this value when linking records. }; /** * For "Users" table operations */ export class Users { /** * Find and return a record from this table (if exists). * @param params.id The unique identifier of the record * @param params.filters Prisma-style where clause for filtering. A direct mapping is an equality check, otherwise use the nested operators. * @param params.fields Optional list of field names to return. When omitted, all fields are returned. Rarely needed. */ static async findOne(params: { id?: string; filters?: RecordFilters<UsersRecordType>; fields?: string[]; }): Promise<UsersRecordType | undefined>; /** * Find and return matching records. IMPORTANT: For large datasets, implement pagination using limit (max 2000 records) and offset parameters. Start with offset 0, increment by records returned, and check hasMore to determine if more records exist * @param params.filters Prisma-style where clause for filtering. A direct mapping is an equality check, otherwise use the nested operators. * @param params.offset Pagination offset - number of records to skip (start at 0) * @param params.limit Pagination limit - defaults to 500, maximum 2000 records * @param params.fields Optional list of field names to return. When omitted, all fields are returned. Rarely needed. */ static async findAll(params: { filters?: RecordFilters<UsersRecordType>; offset?: number | undefined; limit?: number; fields?: string[]; }): Promise<{ records: UsersRecordType[]; hasMore: boolean; }>; /** * Create a new record in this table * @param params.record New record to create in this table */ static async create(params: { record: Partial<UsersRecordType>; }): Promise<UsersRecordType>; /** * Update an existing record in this table * @param params.id (required) ID of the record to update (Can be retrieved from a find/findAll call.) * @param params.record Fields to update */ static async update(params: { id?: string; record: Partial<UsersRecordType>; }): Promise<{ id: string; fields: Partial<UsersRecordType>; }>; /** * Delete a record in this table * @param params.id The unique identifier of the record */ static async delete(params: { id: string; }): Promise<{ id: string; }>; /** * Create multiple records at once (1-100 records per call). Always prefer this over calling create() in a loop. If matchOn provided, will upsert existing records. For more than 100 records, split into multiple bulkCreate calls. * @param params.records Array of records to create (1-100 records maximum) * @param params.matchOn Optional field names for upsert matching */ static async bulkCreate(params: { records: Partial<UsersRecordType>[]; matchOn?: string[] | undefined; }): Promise<{ success: boolean; records: { id: string; fields: Partial<UsersRecordType>; }[]; }>; } /** * For "Announcements" table operations */ export class Announcements { /** * Find and return a record from this table (if exists). * @param params.id The unique identifier of the record * @param params.filters Prisma-style where clause for filtering. A direct mapping is an equality check, otherwise use the nested operators. * @param params.fields Optional list of field names to return. When omitted, all fields are returned. Rarely needed. */ static async findOne(params: { id?: string; filters?: RecordFilters<AnnouncementsRecordType>; fields?: string[]; }): Promise<AnnouncementsRecordType | undefined>; /** * Find and return matching records. IMPORTANT: For large datasets, implement pagination using limit (max 2000 records) and offset parameters. Start with offset 0, increment by records returned, and check hasMore to determine if more records exist * @param params.filters Prisma-style where clause for filtering. A direct mapping is an equality check, otherwise use the nested operators. * @param params.offset Pagination offset - number of records to skip (start at 0) * @param params.limit Pagination limit - defaults to 500, maximum 2000 records * @param params.fields Optional list of field names to return. For more than 100 records, split into multiple bulkCreate calls. * @param params.records Array of records to create (1-100 records maximum) * @param params.matchOn Optional field names for upsert matching */ static async bulkCreate(params: { records: Partial<AnnouncementsRecordType>[]; matchOn?: string[] | undefined; }): Promise<{ success: boolean; records: { id: string; fields: Partial<AnnouncementsRecordType>; }[]; }>; } /** * For "Site Settings" table operations */ export class SiteSettings { /** * Find and return a record from this table (if exists). * @param params.id The unique identifier of the record * @param params.filters Prisma-style where clause for filtering. content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Check if the current user is an admin', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ isAdmin: z.boolean(), user: z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), }), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const record = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const isAdmin = record?.role === 'Admin'; return { isAdmin, user: { id: context.user.id, email: context.user.email, firstName: context.user.firstName, lastName: context.user.lastName, role: record?.role, }, }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/checkAdmin.ts"
