content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all users - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ search: z.string().optional(), roleFilter: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ users: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string().optional(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), joinedAt: z.string().optional(), lastActive: z.string().optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), })), total: z.number(), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await Users.findAll({ limit: 500 }); let filtered = records; if (input.search) { const q = input.search.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ); } if (input.roleFilter && input.roleFilter !== 'all') { filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.role?.toLowerCase() === input.roleFilter?.toLowerCase()); } return { users: filtered.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email, firstName: u.firstName, lastName: u.lastName, role: u.role, joinedAt: u.joinedAt, lastActive: u.lastActive, isActive: u.isActive, })), total: filtered.length, }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/getUsers.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a user role or status - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string(), role: z.enum(['Admin', 'User', 'Banned']).optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } if (input.userId === context.user.id) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'You cannot modify your own account' }); } const updates: Partial<{ role: string; isActive: boolean }> = {}; if (input.role !== undefined) updates.role = input.role; if (input.isActive !== undefined) updates.isActive = input.isActive; await Users.update({ id: input.userId, record: updates }); return { success: true }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/updateUser.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Delete a user - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string() }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } if (input.userId === context.user.id) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'You cannot delete your own account' }); } await Users.delete({ id: input.userId }); return { success: true }; }, }); "

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Announcements, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all announcements - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ announcements: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string().optional(), message: z.string().optional(), status: z.string().optional(), postedAt: z.string().optional(), postedBy: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await Announcements.findAll({ limit: 100 }); return { announcements: records.map(a => ({ id: a.id, title: a.title, message: a.message, status: a.status, postedAt: a.postedAt, postedBy: a.postedBy, })), }; }, }); "

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Announcements, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete an announcement - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), title: z.string().optional(), message: z.string().optional(), status: z.enum(['Active', 'Draft', 'Archived']).optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } if (input.action === 'create') { const record = await Announcements.create({ record: { title: input.title, message: input.message, status: input.status ?? 'Draft', postedAt: new Date().toISOString(), postedBy: context.user.email, }, }); return { success: true, id: record.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await Announcements.update({ id: input.id, record: { title: input.title, message: input.message, status: input.status }, }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { await Announcements.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/manageAnnouncement.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, SiteSettings, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all site settings - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ settings: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), settingKey: z.string().optional(), settingValue: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await SiteSettings.findAll({}); return { settings: records.map(s => ({ id: s.id, settingKey: s.settingKey, settingValue: s.settingValue, description: s.description, })), }; }, }); "

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, SiteSettings, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a site setting - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ key: z.string(), value: z.string(), description: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const existing = await SiteSettings.findOne({ filters: { settingKey: input.key } }); if (existing) { await SiteSettings.update({ id: existing.id, record: { settingValue: input.value } }); } else { await SiteSettings.create({ record: { settingKey: input.key, settingValue: input.value, description: input.description ?? '' }, }); } return { success: true }; }, }); "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getUsers, GetUsersOutputType, updateUser, deleteUser } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Search, Trash2, ShieldCheck, UserX, User, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type UserRow = GetUsersOutputType['users'][0]; const ROLE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = { Admin: 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30', User: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border', Banned: 'bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border-destructive/30', }; export default function UserManager() { const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all'); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<UserRow | null>(null); const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async (s = search, r = roleFilter) => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getUsers({ search: s, roleFilter: r }); setUsers(res.users); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load users'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, role: 'Admin' | 'User' | 'Banned') => { setUpdating(userId); try { await updateUser({ userId, role }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === userId ? { ...u, role } : u)); toast.success('Role updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to update'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleToggleActive = async (user: UserRow) => { setUpdating(user.id); try { await updateUser({ userId: user.id, isActive: !user.isActive }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === user.id ? { ...u, isActive: !u.isActive } : u)); toast.success('Status updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to update'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await deleteUser({ userId: deleteTarget.id }); setUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('User deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to delete'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const handleSearch = (s: string) => { setSearch(s); load(s, roleFilter); }; const handleFilter = (r: string) => { setRoleFilter(r); load(search, r); }; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2"> <div className="relative flex-1"> <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="Search users..." className="pl-9" value={search} onChange={e => handleSearch(e.target.value)} /> </div> <Select value={roleFilter} onValueChange={handleFilter}> <SelectTrigger className="w-36"> <SelectValue placeholder="All roles" /> </SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="all">All Roles</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Admin">Admin</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="User">User</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Banned">Banned</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => load()} title="Refresh"> <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{users.length} user{users.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} found</div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2"> {[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => ( <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" /> ))} </div> ) : users.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No users found</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {users.map(user => ( <div key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"> <User className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> </div> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate"> {user.firstName || user.lastName ? `${user.firstName ?? ''} ${user.lastName ?? ''}`.trim() : user.email} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{user.email}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${ROLE_COLORS[user.role ?? 'User'] ?? ROLE_COLORS.User}`}> {user.role ?? 'User'} </span> <Select value={user.role ?? 'User'} onValueChange={(v) => handleRoleChange(user.id, v as 'Admin' | 'User' | 'Banned')} disabled={updating === user.id} > <SelectTrigger className="h-7 w-24 text-xs"> <SelectValue /> </SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="Admin">Admin</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="User">User</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Banned">Banned</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" title={user.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'} onClick={() => handleToggleActive(user)} disabled={updating === user.id} > {user.isActive !== false ? ( <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> ) : ( <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" /> )} </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(user)} disabled={updating === user.id} > <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete User</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription> Are you sure you want to permanently delete <strong>{deleteTarget?.email}</strong>? This cannot be undone. </AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getAnnouncements, manageAnnouncement, GetAnnouncementsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Plus, Trash2, Pencil, Megaphone, Check } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type Ann = GetAnnouncementsOutputType['announcements'][0]; const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = { Active: 'text-green-400 bg-green-400/10 border-green-400/20', Draft: 'text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-400/10 border-yellow-400/20', Archived: 'text-muted-foreground bg-muted/40 border-border', }; export default function AnnouncementManager() { const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<Ann[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Partial<Ann> | null>(null); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<Ann | null>(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getAnnouncements({}); setAnnouncements(res.announcements); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load announcements'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleSave = async () => { if (!editing?.title?.trim()) { toast.error('Title is required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editing.id) { await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'update', id: editing.id, title: editing.title, message: editing.message ?? '', status: (editing.status as any) ?? 'Draft' }); setAnnouncements(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === editing.id ? { ...a, ...editing } : a)); toast.success('Announcement updated'); } else { const res = await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'create', title: editing.title, message: editing.message ?? '', status: (editing.status as any) ?? 'Draft' }); await load(); toast.success('Announcement created'); } setEditing(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to save'); } setSaving(false); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await manageAnnouncement({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); setAnnouncements(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('Deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to delete'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; if (editing !== null) { return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>← Back</Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editing.id ? 'Edit Announcement' : 'New Announcement'}</span> </div> <Input placeholder="Title" value={editing.title ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, title: e.target.value }))} /> <textarea className="w-full bg-background border border-border rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-foreground resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 h-28" placeholder="Message..." value={editing.message ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, message: e.target.value }))} /> <Select value={editing.status ?? 'Draft'} onValueChange={v => setEditing(prev => ({ ...prev, status: v }))}> <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="Active">Active</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Draft">Draft</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Archived">Archived</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'} </Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); } return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{announcements.length} announcement{announcements.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing({ status: 'Draft' })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> New </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-16 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : announcements.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No announcements yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {announcements.map(ann => ( <div key={ann.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4 text-primary mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{ann.title}</div> {ann.message && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate mt-0.5">{ann.message}</div>} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${STATUS_COLORS[ann.status ?? 'Draft'] ?? STATUS_COLORS.Draft}`}> {ann.status ?? 'Draft'} </span> {ann.postedBy && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">by {ann.postedBy}</span>} </div> </div> <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => setEditing(ann)}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(ann)}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Announcement</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Delete "<strong>{deleteTarget?.title}</strong>"? This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getSiteSettings, updateSiteSetting } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import { Settings, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'; const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = [ { key: 'maintenance_mode', label: 'Maintenance Mode', description: 'Show a maintenance page to all visitors', default: 'false' }, { key: 'new_registrations', label: 'New Registrations', description: 'Allow new users to sign up', default: 'true' }, { key: 'game_access', label: 'Game Access', description: 'Allow users to access the games hub', default: 'true' }, { key: 'proxy_access', label: 'Proxy Access', description: 'Allow users to access the proxy hub', default: 'true' }, { key: 'show_announcements', label: 'Show Announcements', description: 'Display active announcements to users', default: 'true' }, ]; export default function SiteControls() { const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({}); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [saving, setSaving] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getSiteSettings({}); const map: Record<string, string> = {}; for (const s of res.settings) { if (s.settingKey) map[s.settingKey] = s.settingValue ?? ''; } setValues(map); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load settings'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const toggle = async (key: string, currentValue: string) => { const newVal = currentValue === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'; setSaving(key); try { await updateSiteSetting({ key, value: newVal }); setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: newVal })); toast.success('Setting updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to update'); } setSaving(null); }; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"> <Settings className="w-4 h-4" /> Site-wide toggles </div> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={load} className="h-7 w-7"> <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-3">{[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2"> {DEFAULT_SETTINGS.map(setting => { const val = values[setting.key] ?? setting.default; const isOn = val === 'true'; const isSaving = saving === setting.key; return ( <div key={setting.key} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-3"> <div> <div className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{setting.label}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{setting.description}</div> </div> <button onClick={() => toggle(setting.key, val)} disabled={isSaving} className={`relative inline-flex items-center w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none ${isOn ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-border'} ${isSaving ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`} > <span className={`inline-block w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full shadow transition-transform ${isOn ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'}`} /> </button> </div> ); })} </div> )} </div> ); } "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { X, Gamepad2, Globe, Shield, ExternalLink, Zap, ChevronRight, LogIn, Users, Megaphone, Settings, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { useAuth } from 'zite-auth-sdk'; import { checkAdmin } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import UserManager from './admin/UserManager'; import AnnouncementManager from './admin/AnnouncementManager'; import SiteControls from './admin/SiteControls'; import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner'; const games = [ { name: 'Slope', url: 'https://slope-game.github.io/', emoji: '🎿', desc: 'Roll a ball down a never-ending slope' }, { name: '1v1.LOL', url: 'https://1v1.lol', emoji: '🏗️', desc: 'Build & battle shooter' }, { name: 'Shell Shockers', url: 'https://shellshock.io', emoji: '🥚', desc: 'Egg-based FPS game' }, { name: 'Krunker.io', url: 'https://krunker.io', emoji: '🔫', desc: 'Fast-paced browser FPS' }, { name: 'Agar.io', url: 'https://agar.io', emoji: '🔵', desc: 'Eat cells and grow big' }, { name: 'Slither.io', url: 'https://slither.io', emoji: '🐍', desc: 'Classic snake multiplayer' }, { name: 'Paper.io 2', url: 'https://paper-io.com', emoji: '📄', desc: 'Claim territory on the map' }, { name: 'Geometry Dash', url: 'https://geometrydash.io', emoji: '🔷', desc: 'Rhythm-based platformer' }, { name: 'Drift Boss', url: 'https://driftboss.io', emoji: '🚗', desc: 'Drift around corners endlessly' }, { name: 'Cookie Clicker', url: 'https://orteil.dashnet.org/cookieclicker/', emoji: '🍪', desc: 'Idle clicking game' }, { name: 'Wordle', url: 'https://www.nytimes.com/games/wordle/index.html', emoji: '🟩', desc: 'Guess the 5-letter word' }, { name: 'Pac-Man', url: 'https://freepacman.org', emoji: '👾', desc: 'Classic arcade game' }, ]; const proxies = [ { name: 'Ultraviolet', url: 'https://uv.arethun.net', emoji: '🌐', desc: 'Popular web proxy service' }, { name: 'Titanium Network', url: 'https://titaniumnetwork.org', emoji: '⚡', desc: 'Open-source proxy network' }, { name: 'Holy Unblocker', url: 'https://holyubofficial.net', emoji: '✝️', desc: 'Reliable unblocking proxy' }, { name: 'Interstellar', url: 'https://interstellar.arethun.net', emoji: '🚀', desc: 'Fast, modern proxy' }, { name: 'Nebula Proxy', url: 'https://nebulaproxy.io', emoji: '🌌', desc: 'Clean and simple proxy' }, { name: '3kh0', url: 'https://3kh0.github.io', emoji: '🎮', desc: 'Games & proxy hub' }, ]; type AdminTab = 'overview' | 'users' | 'announcements' | 'settings'; export default function SecretHub({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) { const [tab, setTab] = useState<'games' | 'proxies' | 'admin'>('games'); const { user, isLoading, loginWithRedirect } = useAuth(); const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false); const [adminChecked, setAdminChecked] = useState(false); const [adminTab, setAdminTab] = useState<AdminTab>('overview'); useEffect(() => { if (!isLoading && user) { checkAdmin({}).then(res => { setIsAdmin(res.isAdmin); setAdminChecked(true); }).catch(() => setAdminChecked(true)); } else if (!isLoading) { setAdminChecked(true); } }, [user, isLoading]); return ( <> <Toaster /> <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4" > <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }} animate={{ scale: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }} className="bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl" > {/* Header */} <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border bg-muted/30"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" /> <span className="font-bold text-foreground text-lg">Genizy Hub</span> <span className="text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">SECRET</span> {isAdmin && ( <span className="text-xs bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">ADMIN</span> )} </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> {user && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block">{user.email}</span>} <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"> <X className="w-5 h-5" /> </button> </div> </div> {/* Tabs */} <div className="flex border-b border-border overflow-x-auto"> {[ { id: 'games', label: 'Games', icon: Gamepad2 }, { id: 'proxies', label: 'Proxies', icon: Globe }, { id: 'admin', label: 'Admin', icon: Shield }, ].map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id as typeof tab)} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap ${ tab === t.id ? 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground' }`} > <t.icon className="w-4 h-4" /> {t.label} {t.id === 'admin' && isAdmin && ( <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-400 ml-0.5" /> )} </button> ))} </div> {/* Content */} <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"> {tab === 'games' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">Click any game to open it in a new tab.</p> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {games.map(game => ( <a key={game.name} href={game.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="group bg-muted/40 hover:bg-primary/10 border border-border hover:border-primary/50 rounded-xl p-4 transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5"> <div className="text-3xl mb-2">{game.emoji}</div> <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"> {game.name} <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" /> </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 leading-snug">{game.desc}</div> </a> ))} </div> </div> )} {tab === 'proxies' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">Access web proxies to browse freely. Links open in a new tab.</p> <div className="space-y-3"> {proxies.map(proxy => ( <a key={proxy.name} href={proxy.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="group flex items-center justify-between bg-muted/40 hover:bg-primary/10 border border-border hover:border-primary/50 rounded-xl px-5 py-4 transition-all duration-200"> <div className="flex items-center gap-4"> <span className="text-2xl">{proxy.emoji}</span> <div> <div className="font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{proxy.name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{proxy.desc}</div> </div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors"> Open <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> </div> </a> ))} </div> </div> )} {tab === 'admin' && ( <AdminSection user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} adminChecked={adminChecked} isLoading={isLoading} loginWithRedirect={loginWithRedirect} adminTab={adminTab} setAdminTab={setAdminTab} /> )} </div> </motion.div> </motion.div> </> ); } function AdminSection({ user, isAdmin, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminTab, setAdminTab }: { user: any; isAdmin: boolean; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">You need to be signed in with an admin account to access this panel.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); text type
"Here's everything that was built: --- ### 🔐 How Admin Access Works - **No password required** — the admin panel checks if your **logged-in account has the Admin role** in the database - If not signed in → shows a **Sign In** button - If signed in but not admin → shows **Access Denied** - If signed in as admin → full panel unlocks instantly ✅ ### 👑 Admin Panel (4 tabs inside the Hub) 1. **Overview** — Site stats at a glance 2. **Users** — Full user manager: - Search & filter by role - Change any user's role (Admin / User / Banned) via dropdown - Toggle active/inactive status - Delete users with confirmation dialog 3. **Announcements** — Create, edit, and delete announcements with Active/Draft/Archived status 4. **Site Controls** — Toggle switches for: Maintenance Mode, New Registrations, Game Access, Proxy Access, Show Announcements ### 🏁 To Make Yourself an Admin Go to the **Database tab** in the Zite editor → **Users** table → find your user record → set the **Role** field to `Admin`. Next time you open the hub, you'll have full access." "text"

"create" "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all users - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ search: z.string().optional(), roleFilter: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ users: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string().optional(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), joinedAt: z.string().optional(), lastActive: z.string().optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), })), total: z.number(), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } const { records } = await Users.findAll({ limit: 500 }); let filtered = records; if (input.search) { const q = input.search.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ); } if (input.roleFilter && input.roleFilter !== 'all') { filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.role?.toLowerCase() === input.roleFilter?.toLowerCase()); } return { users: filtered.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email, firstName: u.firstName, lastName: u.lastName, role: u.role, joinedAt: u.joinedAt, lastActive: u.lastActive, isActive: u.isActive, })), total: filtered.length, }; }, }); " "src/api/getUsers.ts"
"create" "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a user role or status - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string(), role: z.enum(['Admin', 'User', 'Banned']).optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (callerRecord?.role !== 'Admin') { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin access required' }); } if (input.userId === context.user.id) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'You cannot modify your own account' }); } const updates: Partial<{ role: string; isActive: boolean }> = {}; if (input.role !== undefined) updates.role = input.role; if (input.isActive !== undefined) updates.isActive = input.isActive; await Users.update({ id: input.userId, record: updates }); return { success: true }; }, }); " "src/api/updateUser.ts"

nonDevSummary: "I've built out the full custom tabs system for your hub! Admins can now create and manage tabs that instantly show up for everyone. <list icon="tabs">Create custom tabs with a name and emoji — choose between a single featured site or a grid of multiple sites</list> <list icon="settings">Manage everything from Admin → Hub Tabs: add, edit, delete tabs and their links in real time</list> <list icon="monitor">Every link has three ways to open it — inside the hub, in a cloaked window (hides the URL), or fullscreen</list> <list icon="grid">Multi-item tabs display as a sleek dark grid with glowing cards, each with those same three open options</list> <list icon="refresh-cw">Hit the refresh button in the hub to see any admin changes instantly</list>"
 "Good. Now let me build all the pieces:Now the admin tab manager and the updated SecretHub:Now update SecretHub to load and render custom tabs:Here's everything that was built: --- ### 🗂️ Custom Hub Tabs System **How it works (for admins):** 1. Open the hub (type `genizy`) → go to **Admin → Hub Tabs** 2. Click **New Tab** → give it a name, emoji, and choose **Single** or **Multiple** 3. Click **Items** to add URLs to that tab 4. The tab instantly appears in the hub for everyone --- ### Tab Types **Single Item Tab** - Only uses the first item you add - Shows a big launch screen with 3 buttons: - 🖥️ **Open as iframe** — loads inside the hub - 🔗 **Cloaked new tab** — opens in a blank window (URL bar shows `about:blank`) - ⛶ **Fullscreen** — iframe that fills the whole screen **Multiple Items Tab** - All items shown as a dark **gaming-style grid** with glow hover effects - Each card has 3 pill buttons: **Iframe**, **Cloaked**, **Full** - Smooth animations and hover effects --- ### ⚙️ Admin: Hub Tabs Manager - Create / edit / delete tabs - Manage items per tab (name, URL, emoji, description) - Sort order control - Changes reflect in the hub immediately (use the 🔄 refresh button)"
version: "v5"
messages:
role content
"assistant"
text type providerOptions input toolName toolCallId
"The user wants admins to be able to create custom tabs in the Secret Hub. These tabs can be: 1. **Single item** - opens directly as an iframe with fullscreen option and cloaked new tab option 2. **Multiple items** - shown in a gaming/modern grid layout, each item has: open in cloaked new tab, open as iframe, fullscreen option I need to: 1. Add a database table for "Hub Tabs" and "Hub Tab Items" 2. Create admin UI to manage these tabs (create/edit/delete tabs, add items to tabs) 3. Update SecretHub to dynamically show these tabs 4. Create iframe viewer with fullscreen + cloaked tab options 5. For the cloaked tab feature, I'll use the about:blank approach with document.write to hide the actual URL Now I'm mapping out the database schema with HubTabs storing the tab metadata like name, icon, and type, while HubItems holds the individual entries with their URLs and descriptions. I'll need API endpoints to fetch and manage these, an admin component to handle CRUD operations, and then integrate the dynamic tabs into the Secret Hub interface. I'm also building a frameViewer component that supports fullscreen mode for displaying the linked content." "reasoning"

Frontend components: - IframeViewer - fullscreen iframe with cloaked new tab + fullscreen buttons - HubTabContent - renders single or multi layout for a custom tab - TabManager (admin) - create/edit/delete tabs and items 5. sdk: "// Base SDK exports - always available /** Filter operators for querying records (Prisma-style) */ type FilterOperators<T> = { not?: T; in?: T[]; notIn?: T[]; lt?: number | Date; lte?: number | Date; gt?: number | Date; gte?: number | Date; contains?: any; } | T; /** Filter type for record queries - use field names as keys with FilterOperators or direct values for equality */ type RecordFilters<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: FilterOperators<T[K]> }; /** Helper type to infer schema output type */ type InferSchemaType<T> = T extends { _output: infer U } ? U : T; /** Stream interface for streaming endpoints */ type ZiteStreamInterface = { /** Write a chunk to the stream (sent to frontend in real-time) */ write: (data: any) => Promise<void>; /** Forward an AsyncIterable to the stream and collect the result */ forward: (asyncIterable: AsyncIterable<string>) => Promise<string>; }; /** Error class for endpoint errors with typed error codes */ type ZiteErrorCode = 'BAD_REQUEST' | 'UNAUTHORIZED' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND' | 'CONFLICT' | 'RATE_LIMITED' | 'INTERNAL_ERROR'; declare class ZiteError extends Error { code: ZiteErrorCode; /** Create a ZiteError with a code and message */ constructor(options: { code: ZiteErrorCode; message: string }); } /** Context type for endpoint execute functions */ type ZiteRequestContext = { user: { id: string; // The user's unique record ID. IMPORTANT: Use this value when you need to link records to the current user (e.g., for 'createdBy' or 'owner' linked record fields). email: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string; role?: "Admin" | "User" | "Banned" | string; joinedAt?: string; lastActive?: string; isActive?: boolean; }; }; /** Create a typed streaming endpoint (stream is always available when stream: true) */ declare function createEndpoint<TInput, TOutput>(config: { /** Optional unique identifier for the endpoint */ id?: string; /** Description of what this endpoint does */ description?: string; /** Whether this endpoint requires authentication (only applies when auth is enabled) */ authenticated?: boolean; /** Enable streaming — the stream parameter will be available in execute */ stream: true; /** Zod schema for input validation */ inputSchema: TInput; /** Zod schema for output validation */ outputSchema: TOutput; /** The endpoint implementation */ execute: (params: { input: InferSchemaType<TInput>; context: ZiteRequestContext; /** Streaming interface — use stream.forward() or stream.write() to send chunks */ stream: ZiteStreamInterface; }) => Promise<InferSchemaType<TOutput>>; }): { inputSchema: TInput; outputSchema: TOutput; }; /** Create a typed backend endpoint */ declare function createEndpoint<TInput, TOutput>(config: { /** Optional unique identifier for the endpoint */ id?: string; /** Description of what this endpoint does */ description?: string; /** Whether this endpoint requires authentication (only applies when auth is enabled) */ authenticated?: boolean; stream?: false; /** Zod schema for input validation */ inputSchema: TInput; /** Zod schema for output validation */ outputSchema: TOutput; /** The endpoint implementation */ execute: (params: { input: InferSchemaType<TInput>; context: ZiteRequestContext; }) => Promise<InferSchemaType<TOutput>>; }): { inputSchema: TInput; outputSchema: TOutput; }; export { ZiteError, createEndpoint }; // ------------------ // Zite Database SDK v1.0.0 // Defines the typescript classes/functions to interact with the tables in this base. // The SDK class and field names are stable identifiers that don't change when renamed. Each table and field has a comment with its current user-facing name in quotes (e.g., // "Task Name"). // Important: The quoted name reflects the most up-to-date name and meaning of the field. // If the SDK name differs from the quoted name, it means the field was renamed. The quoted name is the source of truth for the meaning of the field. // Fields may include display configuration in their comments. Values from the database are raw (e.g. ISO strings for dates); your app should format them for display according to these configs. // LINKED RECORDS: Fields marked "Links to X table" reference records in table X. Values must be UUID record IDs (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33") from findOne/findAll - never use fake IDs. // AI FIELDS: Fields marked "(AI field)" have values automatically generated by AI. They do not compute instantly and may populate after a delay. /** * Some helpful tips when using this SDK: * - IMPORTANT: Rate limit is up to 50 requests per second per base. * - To avoid hitting rate limits: * - Use bulkCreate() instead of calling create() in a loop * - Use findAll() with filters/pagination instead of calling findOne() repeatedly in a loop * - Keep large data operations paginated and chunked rather than one-record-at-a-time * - If handling many requests, add retry logic for 429 responses */ /** * Type definition for a record in the "Users" table */ export type UsersRecordType = { email?: string; // Primary field, "Email" firstName?: string; // "First Name" lastName?: string; // "Last Name" role?: "Admin" | "User" | "Banned" | string; // "Role" joinedAt?: string; // "Joined At", Date and time field. Value is an ISO string; display to user as "local" date (e.g. 2/8/2026) with 12h time (2:30 PM) lastActive?: string; // "Last Active" isActive?: boolean; // "Is Active" id: string; // Unique UUID identifier for this record (e.g., "9dceaa44-3f0e-4071-947c-2a9ab6bb4c33"). Use this value when linking records. }; /** * Type definition for a record in the "Announcements" table */ export type AnnouncementsRecordType = { title?: string; // Primary field, "Title" message?: string; // "Message" status?: "Active" | "Draft" | "Archived" | string; // "Status" postedAt?: string; // "Posted At", Date and time field. content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubTabs, HubItems } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; const itemSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), itemName: z.string().optional(), url: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), }); const tabSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), tabName: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), tabType: z.string().optional(), sortOrder: z.number().optional(), items: z.array(itemSchema), }); export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all hub tabs with their items (public)', inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ tabs: z.array(tabSchema) }), execute: async () => { const [{ records: tabs }, { records: items }] = await Promise.all([ HubTabs.findAll({ limit: 100 }), HubItems.findAll({ limit: 500 }), ]); const sorted = [...tabs].sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder ?? 0) - (b.sortOrder ?? 0)); return { tabs: sorted.map(t => ({ id: t.id, tabName: t.tabName, emoji: t.emoji, tabType: t.tabType, sortOrder: t.sortOrder, items: items .filter(i => i.tabId === t.id) .map(i => ({ id: i.id, itemName: i.itemName, url: i.url, emoji: i.emoji, description: i.description })), })), }; }, }); "

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubTabs, HubItems, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete a hub tab — admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), tabName: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), tabType: z.enum(['Single', 'Multiple']).optional(), sortOrder: z.number().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (caller?.role !== 'Admin') throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin only' }); if (input.action === 'create') { const rec = await HubTabs.create({ record: { tabName: input.tabName, emoji: input.emoji, tabType: input.tabType ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: input.sortOrder ?? 0 }, }); return { success: true, id: rec.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await HubTabs.update({ id: input.id, record: { tabName: input.tabName, emoji: input.emoji, tabType: input.tabType, sortOrder: input.sortOrder } }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { // Delete all items belonging to this tab first const { records: items } = await HubItems.findAll({ filters: { tabId: input.id } }); await Promise.all(items.map(i => HubItems.delete({ id: i.id }))); await HubTabs.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/manageHubTab.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, HubItems, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Create, update, or delete a hub item — admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['create', 'update', 'delete']), id: z.string().optional(), tabId: z.string().optional(), itemName: z.string().optional(), url: z.string().optional(), emoji: z.string().optional(), description: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean(), id: z.string().optional() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); if (caller?.role !== 'Admin') throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin only' }); if (input.action === 'create') { const rec = await HubItems.create({ record: { itemName: input.itemName, url: input.url, emoji: input.emoji, description: input.description, tabId: input.tabId }, }); return { success: true, id: rec.id }; } if (input.action === 'update' && input.id) { await HubItems.update({ id: input.id, record: { itemName: input.itemName, url: input.url, emoji: input.emoji, description: input.description } }); return { success: true, id: input.id }; } if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) { await HubItems.delete({ id: input.id }); return { success: true }; } throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Invalid action' }); }, }); "

content: "import { useState, useRef } from 'react'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; import { X, Maximize2, Minimize2, ExternalLink, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; interface Props { url: string; title: string; emoji?: string; onClose: () => void; } export function openCloaked(url: string, title: string) { const w = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); if (!w) return; w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${title}</title><style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}html,body,iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;overflow:hidden}</style></head><body><iframe src="${url}" allowfullscreen allow="autoplay; fullscreen"></iframe></body></html>`); w.document.close(); } export default function IframeViewer({ url, title, emoji, onClose }: Props) { const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false); const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const toggleFullscreen = () => { if (!isFullscreen) { containerRef.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } else { document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } setIsFullscreen(!isFullscreen); }; return ( <AnimatePresence> <motion.div ref={containerRef} initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] bg-black flex flex-col" > {/* Toolbar */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-card border-b border-border shrink-0"> <button onClick={onClose} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors text-sm"> <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back </button> <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"> {emoji && <span>{emoji}</span>} <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate max-w-xs">{title}</span> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title="Open cloaked in new tab" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, title)} > <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title={isFullscreen ? content: "import { useState } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { ExternalLink, Maximize2, Monitor } from 'lucide-react'; import IframeViewer, { openCloaked } from './IframeViewer'; import { GetHubTabsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; type HubTab = GetHubTabsOutputType['tabs'][0]; type HubItem = HubTab['items'][0]; interface Props { tab: HubTab; } export default function HubTabContent({ tab }: Props) { const [iframeItem, setIframeItem] = useState<HubItem | null>(null); if (iframeItem) { return ( <IframeViewer url={iframeItem.url ?? ''} title={iframeItem.itemName ?? ''} emoji={iframeItem.emoji ?? undefined} onClose={() => setIframeItem(null)} /> ); } // Single item — auto-show as iframe with action buttons if (tab.tabType === 'Single' && tab.items.length > 0) { const item = tab.items[0]; return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-64 gap-6 py-8"> <div className="text-6xl">{item.emoji || tab.emoji || '🌐'}</div> <div className="text-center"> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1">{item.itemName}</div> {item.description && <div className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{item.description}</div>} </div> <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center"> <ActionBtn icon={<Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Open as iframe" onClick={() => setIframeItem(item)} primary /> <ActionBtn icon={<ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Cloaked new tab" onClick={() => openCloaked(item.url ?? '', item.itemName ?? '')} /> <ActionBtn icon={<Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Fullscreen iframe" onClick={() => { setIframeItem(item); }} /> </div> </div> ); } // Multiple items — gaming/modern grid return ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-5"> {tab.items.length} item{tab.items.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · Click a card to open </p> {tab.items.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-14 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No items yet</div> ) : ( <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4"> {tab.items.map((item, i) => ( <motion.div key={item.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} > <MultiItemCard item={item} onIframe={() => setIframeItem(item)} /> </motion.div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); } function MultiItemCard({ item, onIframe }: { item: HubItem; onIframe: () => void }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className="relative group rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5" > {/* Glow effect */} <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> <div className="relative p-5"> <div className="text-4xl mb-3">{item.emoji || '🌐'}</div> <div className="font-bold text-foreground mb-0.5 text-base">{item.itemName}</div> {item.description && ( <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{item.description}</div> )} {/* Action row */} <div className={`flex gap-2 transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-60 translate-y-1'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(item.url ?? '', item.itemName ?? '')} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </div> ); } function ActionBtn({ icon, label, onClick, primary }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void; primary?: boolean }) { return ( <button onClick={onClick} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150 border ${ primary ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground border-primary hover:opacity-90' : 'bg-muted/40 text-foreground border-border hover:bg-primary/10 hover:border-primary/40' }`} > {icon} {label} </button> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors" > {icon} {label} </button> ); } "

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getHubTabs, manageHubTab, manageHubItem, GetHubTabsOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Plus, Trash2, Pencil, ChevronRight, ArrowLeft, Check, Layers, Link } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'; type HubTab = GetHubTabsOutputType['tabs'][0]; type HubItem = HubTab['items'][0]; type View = 'tabs' | 'items' | 'editTab' | 'editItem'; export default function TabManager() { const [tabs, setTabs] = useState<HubTab[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [view, setView] = useState<View>('tabs'); const [selectedTab, setSelectedTab] = useState<HubTab | null>(null); const [editingTab, setEditingTab] = useState<Partial<HubTab> | null>(null); const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<Partial<HubItem & { tabId?: string }> | null>(null); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<{ type: 'tab' | 'item'; id: string; name: string } | null>(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getHubTabs({}); setTabs(res.tabs); if (selectedTab) { const updated = res.tabs.find(t => t.id === selectedTab.id); if (updated) setSelectedTab(updated); } } catch { toast.error('Failed to load tabs'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); // Save tab const saveTab = async () => { if (!editingTab?.tabName?.trim()) { toast.error('Tab name required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editingTab.id) { await manageHubTab({ action: 'update', id: editingTab.id, tabName: editingTab.tabName, emoji: editingTab.emoji ?? '', tabType: (editingTab.tabType as 'Single' | 'Multiple') ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: editingTab.sortOrder ?? 0 }); toast.success('Tab updated'); } else { await manageHubTab({ action: 'create', tabName: editingTab.tabName, emoji: editingTab.emoji ?? '', tabType: (editingTab.tabType as 'Single' | 'Multiple') ?? 'Multiple', sortOrder: editingTab.sortOrder ?? 0 }); toast.success('Tab created'); } await load(); setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setSaving(false); }; // Save item const saveItem = async () => { if (!editingItem?.itemName?.trim()) { toast.error('Item name required'); return; } if (!editingItem?.url?.trim()) { toast.error('URL required'); return; } setSaving(true); try { if (editingItem.id) { await manageHubItem({ action: 'update', id: editingItem.id, itemName: editingItem.itemName, url: editingItem.url, emoji: editingItem.emoji ?? '', description: editingItem.description ?? '' }); toast.success('Item updated'); } else { await manageHubItem({ action: 'create', tabId: selectedTab?.id, itemName: editingItem.itemName, url: editingItem.url, emoji: editingItem.emoji ?? '', description: editingItem.description ?? '' }); toast.success('Item added'); } await load(); setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setSaving(false); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { if (deleteTarget.type === 'tab') { await manageHubTab({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); setSelectedTab(null); setView('tabs'); toast.success('Tab deleted'); } else { await manageHubItem({ action: 'delete', id: deleteTarget.id }); toast.success('Item deleted'); } await load(); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed to delete'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const renderTabList = () => ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex justify-between items-center"> <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{tabs.length} custom tab{tabs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingTab({ tabType: 'Multiple', sortOrder: tabs.length }); setView('editTab'); }}> <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> New Tab </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : tabs.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No custom tabs yet. Create one to get started.</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {tabs.map(tab => ( <div key={tab.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3 group"> <span className="text-xl">{tab.emoji || '📋'}</span> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{tab.tabName}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{tab.tabType} · {tab.items?.length ?? 0} item{(tab.items?.length ?? 0) !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs gap-1" onClick={() => { setSelectedTab(tab); setView('items'); }}> Items <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => { setEditingTab(tab); setView('editTab'); }}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget({ type: 'tab', id: tab.id, name: tab.tabName ?? '' })}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); const renderItemList = () => ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setView('tabs')}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{selectedTab?.emoji} {selectedTab?.tabName}</span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-muted border border-border">{selectedTab?.tabType}</span> </div> <div className="flex justify-end"> <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setEditingItem({}); setView('editItem'); }}> <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Add Item </Button> </div> {(selectedTab?.items?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No items yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {selectedTab?.items?.map(item => ( <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <span className="text-lg">{item.emoji || '🔗'}</span> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{item.itemName}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{item.url}</div> </div> <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => { setEditingItem(item); setView('editItem'); }}> <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget({ type: 'item', id: item.id, name: item.itemName ?? '' })}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); const renderEditTab = () => ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); }}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editingTab?.id ? 'Edit Tab' : 'New Tab'}</span> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2"> <Input placeholder="Emoji" value={editingTab?.emoji ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, emoji: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-1" /> <Input placeholder="Tab name" value={editingTab?.tabName ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, tabName: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-3" /> </div> <div className="space-y-1"> <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Tab Type</label> <Select value={editingTab?.tabType ?? 'Multiple'} onValueChange={v => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, tabType: v }))}> <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="Multiple">Multiple Items — grid layout</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Single">Single Item — direct launch</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-1"> {editingTab?.tabType === 'Single' ? 'Only the first item is used. It opens directly with iframe/fullscreen/cloaked options.' : 'All items shown as a gaming-style grid. Each card has its own launch options.'} </p> </div> <Input placeholder="Sort order (0 = first)" type="number" value={editingTab?.sortOrder ?? 0} onChange={e => setEditingTab(p => ({ ...p, sortOrder: Number(e.target.value) }))} /> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={saveTab} disabled={saving}><Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Tab'}</Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setView('tabs'); setEditingTab(null); }}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); const renderEditItem = () => ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2"> <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); }}><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button> <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{editingItem?.id ? 'Edit Item' : 'New Item'}</span> </div> <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2"> <Input placeholder="Emoji" value={editingItem?.emoji ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, emoji: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-1" /> <Input placeholder="Item name" value={editingItem?.itemName ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, itemName: e.target.value }))} className="col-span-3" /> </div> <div className="relative"> <Link className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="https://example.com" value={editingItem?.url ?? ''} onChange={e => setEditingItem(p => ({ ...p, description: e.target.value }))} /> <div className="flex gap-2"> <Button onClick={saveItem} disabled={saving}><Check className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Item'}</Button> <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setView('items'); setEditingItem(null); }}>Cancel</Button> </div> </div> ); return ( <div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"> <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Custom Hub Tabs</span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">— visible to all hub visitors</span> </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={view} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {view === 'tabs' && renderTabList()} {view === 'items' && renderItemList()} {view === 'editTab' && renderEditTab()} {view === 'editItem' && renderEditItem()} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete {deleteTarget?.type === 'tab' ? "Here's everything that was built: --- ### 🗂️ Custom Hub Tabs System **How it works (for admins):** 1. Open the hub (type `genizy`) → go to **Admin → Hub Tabs** 2. Click **New Tab** → give it a name, emoji, and choose **Single** or **Multiple** 3. Click **Items** to add URLs to that tab 4. The tab instantly appears in the hub for everyone --- ### Tab Types **Single Item Tab** - Only uses the first item you add - Shows a big launch screen with 3 buttons: - 🖥️ **Open as iframe** — loads inside the hub - 🔗 **Cloaked new tab** — opens in a blank window (URL bar shows `about:blank`) - ⛶ **Fullscreen** — iframe that fills the whole screen **Multiple Items Tab** - All items shown as a dark **gaming-style grid** with glow hover effects - Each card has 3 pill buttons: **Iframe**, **Cloaked**, **Full** - Smooth animations and hover effects --- ### ⚙️ Admin: Hub Tabs Manager - Create / edit / delete tabs - Manage items per tab (name, URL, emoji, description) - Sort order control - Changes reflect in the hub immediately (use the 🔄 refresh button)" "text"

nonDevSummary: "Every item in your hub — games, proxies, all of it — now has three ways to open it: <list icon="monitor">**Iframe** — opens the site in a popup inside your hub</list> <list icon="link">**Cloaked** — opens in a new window that shows `about:blank` in the address bar, hiding the real URL</list> <list icon="maximize">**Fullscreen** — same as Iframe, but you can expand it to take over your whole screen</list>"
 "Now replace the games and proxies sections with the new card layout:Now add the IframeViewer render and the LaunchCard component. First add the viewer inside the outer fragment, then add the component at the bottom:Now add the `LaunchCard` component at the bottom of the file:Now every item in the hub has the same launch options. The Games and Proxies tabs now show the same gaming-style cards with 3 action pills each — **Iframe**, **Cloaked**, and **Fullscreen** — so nothing in the hub ever opens a plain link. Here's what each does: - 🖥️ **Iframe** — loads the site inside the hub modal - 🔗 **Cloaked** — opens in a new blank window where the URL bar shows `about:blank` instead of the real URL - ⛶ **Fullscreen** — same as iframe but you can hit the fullscreen button in the top bar to go truly fullscreen All three options apply across Games, Proxies, and any custom tabs you create."

content: "import { useState, useRef } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { X, Maximize2, Minimize2, ExternalLink, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; interface Props { url: string; title: string; emoji?: string; onClose: () => void; } export function openCloaked(url: string, title: string) { const w = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); if (!w) return; w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${title}</title><style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}html,body,iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;overflow:hidden}</style></head><body><iframe src="${url}" allowfullscreen allow="autoplay; fullscreen"></iframe></body></html>`); w.document.close(); } export default function IframeViewer({ url, title, emoji, onClose }: Props) { const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false); const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const toggleFullscreen = () => { if (!isFullscreen) { containerRef.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } else { document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {}); } setIsFullscreen(!isFullscreen); }; return ( <motion.div ref={containerRef} initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] bg-black flex flex-col" > {/* Toolbar */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-card border-b border-border shrink-0"> <button onClick={onClose} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors text-sm"> <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back </button> <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"> {emoji && <span>{emoji}</span>} <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate max-w-xs">{title}</span> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-1"> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title="Open cloaked in new tab" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, title)} > <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /> </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title={isFullscreen ? 'Exit fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen'} onClick={toggleFullscreen} > {isFullscreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />} </Button> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={onClose}> <X className="w-4 h-4" /> </Button> </div> </div> {/* Iframe */} <iframe src={url} className="flex-1 w-full border-none" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; accelerometer; gyroscope" allowFullScreen title={title} /> </motion.div> ); } "

nonDevSummary: "Here's everything that got built out for your hub! <list icon="gamepad">Expanded the games library to 60 titles — including Friday Night Funkin', Minecraft Classic, Smash Karts, Among Us, GeoGuessr, Uno Online, and loads more</list> <list icon="shield">Grew the proxy list to 20 options, adding Shadow, Eclipse, Comet, Lunar, Aether, Onyx, Nova, Flux, and more</list> <list icon="crown">Set up a 3-tier staff system — Owners can do everything including managing Admins, Admins handle content and users, and Moderators can ban/unban regular users</list> <list icon="lock">Staff can only control people ranked below them — no one can touch someone at their level or above</list> <list icon="list">Every role change and account action gets logged in an Audit Log, showing who did what and when</list> <list icon="eye">Each staff tier only sees the admin tools they're actually allowed to use — no extra tabs cluttering things up</list>"
 "The schema already has Owner/Admin/Moderator roles and AuditLog/HubGames/HubProxies tables. Now let me build everything:Now update the UserManager to be role-aware, add AuditLog viewer, and update SecretHub:Now update the SecretHub with massively more games, proxies, and the full role-aware admin system:Now fix the duplicate admin tab button rendering in the tab bar:Also fix the `AdminOverview` props type:Here's everything that was added: --- ### 🎮 Way More Content - **60 games** (up from 30) — Friday Night Funkin, Minecraft Classic, Smash Karts, Skribbl.io, Gartic Phone, GeoGuessr, Among Us, Rooftop Snipers, Vex 6, Crossy Road, FNF, Uno Online, Ludo King + many more - **20 proxies** (up from 12) — Shadow, Eclipse, Comet, Lunar, Aether, Onyx, Nova, Flux Proxy + original ones --- ### 👑 Role System (3 Staff Tiers) | Role | Permissions | |------|------------| | 👑 **Owner** | Everything + promote/demote Admins, delete Admins, assign Owner | | 🛡️ **Admin** | Manage Mods/Users, hub content, site settings, announcements | | 🔰 **Moderator** | View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log | - **Role hierarchy enforced on the backend** — can't modify anyone equal or higher rank - **Audit Log** — every role change and deletion is logged with who did it, to who, and when - **Permission chips** shown in the admin panel so each role sees exactly what they can do - **Admin sub-tabs are gated by role** — Moderators only see Users + Audit Log; Admins get Announcements + Hub Tabs; Owners get everything"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Check if the current user is an admin', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ isAdmin: z.boolean(), user: z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), }), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const record = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const isAdmin = record?.role === 'Admin'; return { isAdmin, user: { id: context.user.id, email: context.user.email, firstName: context.user.firstName, lastName: context.user.lastName, role: record?.role, }, }; }, }); "

"The schema already has Owner, Admin, Moderator, User, Banned roles in the Users table. It also has HubGames, HubProxies, and AuditLog tables. Great, this makes things easier. Let me plan the full implementation: **Role Hierarchy:** Owner > Admin > Moderator > User > Banned - **Owner**: Can do everything + promote/demote admins, delete admins, manage owners - **Admin**: Can manage users (not owners), announcements, hub tabs/games/proxies, site settings, view audit log - **Moderator**: Can ban/unban users, post announcements (drafts only → need approval?), view users, view audit log - **User**: Normal access - **Banned**: No access Now I need to build out the implementation. I'll refactor the admin check into a more comprehensive role system, update the user management endpoints to enforce hierarchy and log actions, create an audit log viewer, expand the admin panel with role-aware controls, and add more games and proxies to the hub. I'll also update the user manager component and SecretHub to display role information. The permission structure breaks down like this: Moderators can view users and manage bans plus draft announcements, Admins get everything Moderators have plus the ability to promote users and manage content, and Owners can do everything including promoting to Admin and managing other Admins. I'm going to start by creating a shared role utility, then systematically update each endpoint and component to use it. Building out the role hierarchy function..." "reasoning"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Check the current user role and permissions', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({}), outputSchema: z.object({ role: z.string(), isOwner: z.boolean(), isAdmin: z.boolean(), isModerator: z.boolean(), canManageUsers: z.boolean(), canManageAdmins: z.boolean(), canManageSite: z.boolean(), canManageHub: z.boolean(), canViewAuditLog: z.boolean(), user: z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), }), }), execute: async ({ context }) => { const record = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const role = record?.role ?? 'User'; const isOwner = role === 'Owner'; const isAdmin = role === 'Admin' || isOwner; const isModerator = role === 'Moderator' || isAdmin; return { role, isOwner, isAdmin, isModerator, canManageUsers: isModerator, canManageAdmins: isOwner, canManageSite: isAdmin, canManageHub: isAdmin, canViewAuditLog: isModerator, user: { id: context.user.id, email: context.user.email, firstName: context.user.firstName, lastName: context.user.lastName, role, }, }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/checkAdmin.ts"
