content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, AuditLog, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; function roleRank(role?: string): number { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; case 'Banned': return 0; default: return 1; } } export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Update a user role or status — enforces role hierarchy', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string(), role: z.enum(['Owner', 'Admin', 'Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']).optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const [caller, target] = await Promise.all([ Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }), Users.findOne({ id: input.userId }), ]); const callerRank = roleRank(caller?.role); const targetRank = roleRank(target?.role); const newRank = input.role ? roleRank(input.role) : targetRank; // Must be at least Moderator if (callerRank < 2) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Insufficient permissions' }); // Cannot modify yourself if (input.userId === context.user.id) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Cannot modify your own account' }); // Cannot target someone of equal or higher rank if (targetRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot modify a user with equal or higher rank' }); // Cannot assign a role equal to or higher than your own if (newRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot assign a role equal to or higher than yours' }); // Moderators can only ban/unban regular users if (callerRank === 2 && input.role && !['User', 'Banned'].includes(input.role)) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Moderators can only change users to User or Banned' }); } const updates: Partial<{ role: string; isActive: boolean }> = {}; if (input.role !== undefined) updates.role = input.role; if (input.isActive !== undefined) updates.isActive = input.isActive; await Users.update({ id: input.userId, record: updates }); // Log the action await AuditLog.create({ record: { action: input.role ? `Changed role to ${input.role}` : `Updated active status to ${input.isActive}`, performedBy: context.user.email, targetUser: target?.email ?? input.userId, details: `${caller?.role} ${context.user.email} updated user ${target?.email}`, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), roleLevel: caller?.role ?? 'User', }, }); return { success: true }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/updateUser.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, AuditLog, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; function roleRank(role?: string): number { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; case 'Banned': return 0; default: return 1; } } export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Delete a user — enforces role hierarchy', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ userId: z.string() }), outputSchema: z.object({ success: z.boolean() }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const [caller, target] = await Promise.all([ Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }), Users.findOne({ id: input.userId }), ]); const callerRank = roleRank(caller?.role); const targetRank = roleRank(target?.role); if (callerRank < 3) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Only Admins and Owners can delete users' }); if (input.userId === context.user.id) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Cannot delete your own account' }); if (targetRank >= callerRank) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot delete a user with equal or higher rank' }); await AuditLog.create({ record: { action: `Deleted user`, performedBy: context.user.email, targetUser: target?.email ?? input.userId, details: `${caller?.role} ${context.user.email} deleted user ${target?.email}`, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), roleLevel: caller?.role ?? 'Admin', }, }); await Users.delete({ id: input.userId }); return { success: true }; }, }); "

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, AuditLog, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get audit log entries — moderator+ only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ limit: z.number().optional() }), outputSchema: z.object({ entries: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), action: z.string().optional(), performedBy: z.string().optional(), targetUser: z.string().optional(), details: z.string().optional(), timestamp: z.string().optional(), roleLevel: z.string().optional(), })), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const caller = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const rank = caller?.role === 'Owner' ? 4 : caller?.role === 'Admin' ? 3 : caller?.role === 'Moderator' ? 2 : 0; if (rank < 2) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Moderator+ required' }); const { records } = await AuditLog.findAll({ limit: input.limit ?? 100 }); const sorted = [...records].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp ?? 0).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp ?? 0).getTime() ); return { entries: sorted.map(e => ({ id: e.id, action: e.action, performedBy: e.performedBy, targetUser: e.targetUser, details: e.details, timestamp: e.timestamp, roleLevel: e.roleLevel, })), }; }, }); "
filePath: "src/api/getAuditLog.ts"

"Now update the UserManager to be role-aware, add AuditLog viewer, and update SecretHub:" "text"
"tool-call"
content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getUsers, GetUsersOutputType, updateUser, deleteUser } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Search, Trash2, ShieldCheck, UserX, RefreshCw, Crown, Shield, User, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type UserRow = GetUsersOutputType['users'][0]; type RoleName = 'Owner' | 'Admin' | 'Moderator' | 'User' | 'Banned'; const ROLE_META: Record<string, { color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = { Owner: { color: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30', icon: <Crown className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Admin: { color: 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Moderator: { color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> }, User: { color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border', icon: <User className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Banned: { color: 'bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border-destructive/30', icon: <UserX className="w-3 h-3" /> }, }; function roleRank(role?: string) { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; default: return 0; } } function getAssignableRoles(myRole?: string): RoleName[] { switch (myRole) { case 'Owner': return ['Admin', 'Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Admin': return ['Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Moderator': return ['User', 'Banned']; default: return []; } } export default function UserManager({ myRole }: { myRole?: string }) { const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all'); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<UserRow | null>(null); const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async (s = search, r = roleFilter) => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getUsers({ search: s, roleFilter: r }); setUsers(res.users); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load users'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, role: RoleName) => { setUpdating(userId); try { await updateUser({ userId, role }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === userId ? { ...u, role } : u)); toast.success('Role updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleToggleActive = async (user: UserRow) => { setUpdating(user.id); try { await updateUser({ userId: user.id, isActive: !user.isActive }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === user.id ? { ...u, isActive: !u.isActive } : u)); toast.success('Status updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await deleteUser({ userId: deleteTarget.id }); setUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('User deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const assignableRoles = getAssignableRoles(myRole); const canDelete = roleRank(myRole) >= 3; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> {/* Permission hint */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-border"> {myRole === 'Owner' && <><Crown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" /> Owner — full user management, including admins</>} {myRole === 'Admin' && <><Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> Admin — manage Moderators and below</>} {myRole === 'Moderator' && <><ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" /> Moderator — can ban/unban regular users only</>} </div> <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2"> <div className="relative flex-1"> <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="Search users..." className="pl-9" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); load(e.target.value, roleFilter); }} /> </div> <Select value={roleFilter} onValueChange={v => { setRoleFilter(v); load(search, v); }}> <SelectTrigger className="w-36"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="all">All Roles</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Owner">Owner</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Admin">Admin</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Moderator">Moderator</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="User">User</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Banned">Banned</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => load()}><RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /></Button> </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{users.length} user{users.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : users.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No users found</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {users.map(user => { const meta = ROLE_META[user.role ?? 'User'] ?? ROLE_META.User; const targetRank = roleRank(user.role); const myRank = roleRank(myRole); const canModify = targetRank < myRank; return ( <div key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"> {meta.icon} </div> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate"> {user.firstName || user.lastName ? `${user.firstName ?? ''} ${user.lastName ?? ''}`.trim() : user.email} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{user.email}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium flex items-center gap-1 ${meta.color}`}> {meta.icon}{user.role ?? 'User'} </span> {canModify && assignableRoles.length > 0 && ( <Select value={user.role ?? 'User'} onValueChange={v => handleRoleChange(user.id, v as RoleName)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <SelectTrigger className="h-7 w-28 text-xs"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> {assignableRoles.map(r => <SelectItem key={r} value={r}>{r}</SelectItem>)} </SelectContent> </Select> )} {canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => handleToggleActive(user)} disabled={updating === user.id} title={user.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}> {user.isActive !== false ? <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> : <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />} </Button> )} {canDelete && canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(user)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> )} </div> </div> ); })} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete User</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Permanently delete <strong>{deleteTarget?.email}</strong>? This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } "
filePath: "src/components/admin/UserManager.tsx"
 "updateFile" "toolu_01CTVTKBfogmgUQSV6ZYHNue"

content: "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getAuditLog, GetAuditLogOutputType } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { RefreshCw, Crown, Shield, ShieldCheck, ClipboardList } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type Entry = GetAuditLogOutputType['entries'][0]; const ROLE_ICON: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = { Owner: <Crown className="w-3 h-3 text-yellow-400" />, Admin: <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" />, Moderator: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />, }; function formatDate(iso?: string) { if (!iso) return '—'; return new Date(iso).toLocaleString(); } export default function AuditLogViewer() { const [entries, setEntries] = useState<Entry[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const load = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getAuditLog({ limit: 100 }); setEntries(res.entries); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load audit log'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); return ( <div className="space-y-3"> <div className="flex items-center justify-between"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"> <ClipboardList className="w-4 h-4" /> {entries.length} log entries </div> <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={load}> <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> </div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-12 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : entries.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No audit log entries yet</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {entries.map(entry => ( <div key={entry.id} className="bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5"> <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-foreground"> {ROLE_ICON[entry.roleLevel ?? ''] ?? null} {entry.performedBy} </span> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">→</span> <span className="text-xs text-foreground/70">{entry.targetUser}</span> </div> <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">{entry.action}</div> {entry.details && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 truncate">{entry.details}</div>} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">{formatDate(entry.timestamp)}</div> </div> </div> ))} </div> )} </div> ); } "

"update" "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all users - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ search: z.string().optional(), roleFilter: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ users: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string().optional(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), joinedAt: z.string().optional(), lastActive: z.string().optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), })), total: z.number(), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const authorizedRoles = ['Admin', 'Owner']; if (!authorizedRoles.includes(callerRecord?.role)) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Insufficient permissions' }); } } const { records } = await Users.findAll({ limit: 500 }); let filtered = records; if (input.search) { const q = input.search.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ); } if (input.roleFilter && input.roleFilter !== 'all') { filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.role?.toLowerCase() === input.roleFilter?.toLowerCase()); } return { users: filtered.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email, firstName: u.firstName, lastName: u.lastName, role: u.role, joinedAt: u.joinedAt, lastActive: u.lastActive, isActive: u.isActive, })), total: filtered.length, }; }, }); " "src/api/getUsers.ts"

content: "import { z } from 'zod'; import { createEndpoint, Users, ZiteError } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk'; export default createEndpoint({ description: 'Get all users - admin only', authenticated: true, inputSchema: z.object({ search: z.string().optional(), roleFilter: z.string().optional(), }), outputSchema: z.object({ users: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), email: z.string().optional(), firstName: z.string().optional(), lastName: z.string().optional(), role: z.string().optional(), joinedAt: z.string().optional(), lastActive: z.string().optional(), isActive: z.boolean().optional(), })), total: z.number(), }), execute: async ({ input, context }) => { const callerRecord = await Users.findOne({ id: context.user.id }); const authorizedRoles = ['Admin', 'Owner']; if (!authorizedRoles.includes(callerRecord?.role)) { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Insufficient permissions' }); } } const { records } = await Users.findAll({ limit: 500 }); let filtered = records; if (input.search) { const q = input.search.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ); } if (input.roleFilter && input.roleFilter !== 'all') { filtered = filtered.filter(u => u.role?.toLowerCase() === input.roleFilter?.toLowerCase()); } return { users: filtered.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email, firstName: u.firstName, lastName: u.lastName, role: u.role, joinedAt: u.joinedAt, lastActive: u.lastActive, isActive: u.isActive, })), total: filtered.length, }; }, }); "
success: true

These changes collectively enhance the app's functionality, improve user management, and expand the content available to users."

'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> </Button> {user && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block">{user.email}</span>} <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button> </div> </div> {/* Tab Bar */} <div className="flex border-b border-border overflow-x-auto shrink-0"> {allDisplayTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(t.id)} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${activeTab === t.id ? 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> {t.icon ? <t.icon className="w-4 h-4" /> : <span className="text-sm">{(t as any).emoji || '📋'}</span>} {t.label} </button> ))} <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('admin')} className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ml-auto ${activeTab === 'admin' ? } function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } " "src/components/SecretHub.tsx"

} function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className={`relative rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${wide ? 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <Shield className="w-4 h-4" /> Admin {roleInfo?.isModerator && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-destructive" />} </button> </div> {/* Content */} <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={activeTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {activeTab === 'games' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">{GAMES.length} games — hover to launch</p> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3"> {GAMES.map((g, i) => <LaunchCard key={i} name={g.name} url={g.url} emoji={g.emoji} desc={g.desc} onIframe={() => setIframeTarget({ url: g.url, name: g.name, emoji: g.emoji })} />)} </div> </div> )} {activeTab === 'proxies' && ( <div> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-4">{PROXIES.length} proxies — choose how to launch</p> <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3"> {PROXIES.map((p, i) => <LaunchCard key={i} name={p.name} url={p.url} emoji={p.emoji} desc={p.desc} onIframe={() => setIframeTarget({ url: p.url, name: p.name, emoji: p.emoji })} wide />)} </div> </div> )} {activeCustomTab && <HubTabContent tab={activeCustomTab} />} {activeTab === 'admin' && ( <AdminSection user={user} roleInfo={roleInfo} adminChecked={adminChecked} isLoading={isLoading} loginWithRedirect={loginWithRedirect} adminSubTab={adminSubTab} setAdminSubTab={setAdminSubTab} /> )} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> </motion.div> </motion.div> </> ); } function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className={`relative rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${wide ? 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; adminSubTab: AdminSubTab; setAdminSubTab: (t: AdminSubTab) => void; }) { if (isLoading || !adminChecked) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" /> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Checking access...</p> </div> ); } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } " "src/components/SecretHub.tsx"

} function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); return ( <div onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)} className={`relative rounded-xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/60 to-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${wide ? 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; adminSubTab: AdminSubTab; setAdminSubTab: (t: AdminSubTab) => void; }) { if (isLoading || !adminChecked) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" /> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Checking access...</p> </div> ); } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } " "src/components/SecretHub.tsx"

( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; adminSubTab: AdminSubTab; setAdminSubTab: (t: AdminSubTab) => void; }) { if (isLoading || !adminChecked) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" /> <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Checking access...</p> </div> ); } if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } " "src/components/SecretHub.tsx"

} if (!user) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Admin Access</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs">Sign in with an admin, moderator, or owner account.</p> <Button onClick={() => loginWithRedirect({ redirectUrl: window.location.href })} className="flex items-center gap-2"> <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign In </Button> </div> ); } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30' : 'bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-border line-through'}`}> {p.label} </span> ))} </div> <div className="flex gap-1 bg-muted/40 p-1 rounded-xl flex-wrap"> {subTabs.map(t => ( <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setAdminSubTab(t.id as AdminSubTab)} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${adminSubTab === t.id ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); } function AdminOverview({ roleInfo }: { roleInfo: any }) { const stats = [ { label: 'Games', value: String(GAMES.length), icon: '🎮' }, { label: 'Proxies', value: String(PROXIES.length), icon: '🌐' }, { label: 'Subjects', value: '8', icon: '📚' }, { label: 'Lessons', value: '32', icon: '📖' }, ]; const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> ); } " "src/components/SecretHub.tsx"

"update" "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { getUsers, GetUsersOutputType, updateUser, deleteUser } from 'zite-endpoints-sdk'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'; import { Search, Trash2, ShieldCheck, UserX, RefreshCw, Crown, Shield, User, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; type UserRow = GetUsersOutputType['users'][0]; type RoleName = 'Owner' | 'Admin' | 'Moderator' | 'User' | 'Banned'; const ROLE_META: Record<string, { color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = { Owner: { color: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30', icon: <Crown className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Admin: { color: 'bg-primary/20 text-primary border-primary/30', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Moderator: { color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> }, User: { color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border', icon: <User className="w-3 h-3" /> }, Banned: { color: 'bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border-destructive/30', icon: <UserX className="w-3 h-3" /> }, }; function roleRank(role?: string) { switch (role) { case 'Owner': return 4; case 'Admin': return 3; case 'Moderator': return 2; case 'User': return 1; default: return 0; } } function getAssignableRoles(myRole?: string): RoleName[] { switch (myRole) { case 'Owner': return ['Owner', 'Admin', 'Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Admin': return ['Moderator', 'User', 'Banned']; case 'Moderator': return ['User', 'Banned']; default: return []; } } export default function UserManager({ myRole }: { myRole?: string }) { const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[]>([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all'); const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<UserRow | null>(null); const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<string | null>(null); const load = async (s = search, r = roleFilter) => { setLoading(true); try { const res = await getUsers({ search: s, roleFilter: r }); setUsers(res.users); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load users'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { load(); }, []); const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, role: RoleName) => { setUpdating(userId); try { await updateUser({ userId, role }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === userId ? { ...u, role } : u)); toast.success('Role updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleToggleActive = async (user: UserRow) => { setUpdating(user.id); try { await updateUser({ userId: user.id, isActive: !user.isActive }); setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === user.id ? { ...u, isActive: !u.isActive } : u)); toast.success('Status updated'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setUpdating(null); }; const handleDelete = async () => { if (!deleteTarget) return; try { await deleteUser({ userId: deleteTarget.id }); setUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== deleteTarget.id)); toast.success('User deleted'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e?.message ?? 'Failed'); } setDeleteTarget(null); }; const assignableRoles = getAssignableRoles(myRole); const canDelete = roleRank(myRole) >= 3; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> {/* Permission hint */} <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-border"> {myRole === 'Owner' && <><Crown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" /> Owner — full user management, including admins</>} {myRole === 'Admin' && <><Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> Admin — manage Moderators and below</>} {myRole === 'Moderator' && <><ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" /> Moderator — can ban/unban regular users only</>} </div> <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2"> <div className="relative flex-1"> <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" /> <Input placeholder="Search users..." className="pl-9" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); load(e.target.value, roleFilter); }} /> </div> <Select value={roleFilter} onValueChange={v => { setRoleFilter(v); load(search, v); }}> <SelectTrigger className="w-36"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="all">All Roles</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Owner">Owner</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Admin">Admin</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Moderator">Moderator</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="User">User</SelectItem> <SelectItem value="Banned">Banned</SelectItem> </SelectContent> </Select> <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => load()}><RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /></Button> </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{users.length} user{users.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div> {loading ? ( <div className="space-y-2">{[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 animate-pulse" />)}</div> ) : users.length === 0 ? ( <div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No users found</div> ) : ( <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1"> {users.map(user => { const meta = ROLE_META[user.role ?? 'User'] ?? ROLE_META.User; const targetRank = roleRank(user.role); const myRank = roleRank(myRole); const canModify = targetRank < myRank; return ( <div key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3"> <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"> {meta.icon} </div> <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate"> {user.firstName || user.lastName ? `${user.firstName ?? ''} ${user.lastName ?? ''}`.trim() : user.email} </div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{user.email}</div> </div> <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"> <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium flex items-center gap-1 ${meta.color}`}> {meta.icon}{user.role ?? 'User'} </span> {canModify && assignableRoles.length > 0 && ( <Select value={user.role ?? 'User'} onValueChange={v => handleRoleChange(user.id, v as RoleName)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <SelectTrigger className="h-7 w-28 text-xs"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> {assignableRoles.map(r => <SelectItem key={r} value={r}>{r}</SelectItem>)} </SelectContent> </Select> )} {canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => handleToggleActive(user)} disabled={updating === user.id} title={user.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}> {user.isActive !== false ? <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> : <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />} </Button> )} {canDelete && canModify && ( <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(user)} disabled={updating === user.id}> <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> </Button> )} </div> </div> ); })} </div> )} <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Delete User</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Permanently delete <strong>{deleteTarget?.email}</strong>? This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">Delete</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog> </div> ); } " "src/components/admin/UserManager.tsx"

} function LaunchCard({ name, url, emoji, desc, onIframe, wide }: { name: string; url: string; emoji: string; desc: string; onIframe: () => void; wide?: boolean }) { const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false); 'flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4' : 'p-4'}`}> <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 transition-opacity duration-300 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} /> {wide ? ( <> <span className="relative text-3xl shrink-0">{emoji}</span> <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0"> <div className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm mb-0.5">{name}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{desc}</div> <div className="flex gap-2"> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Fullscreen" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </div> </> ) : ( <> <div className="relative text-3xl mb-2">{emoji}</div> <div className="relative font-bold text-sm text-foreground mb-0.5 truncate">{name}</div> <div className="relative text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-snug line-clamp-2">{desc}</div> <div className={`relative flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap transition-all duration-200 ${hovered ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}> <ActionPill icon={<Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Iframe" onClick={onIframe} /> <ActionPill icon={<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Cloaked" onClick={() => openCloaked(url, name)} /> <ActionPill icon={<Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Full" onClick={onIframe} /> </div> </> )} </div> ); } function ActionPill({ icon, label, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; onClick: () => void }) { return ( <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-background/60 border border-border hover:bg-primary/20 hover:border-primary/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors"> {icon} {label} </button> ); } function AdminSection({ user, roleInfo, adminChecked, isLoading, loginWithRedirect, adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab }: { user: any; roleInfo: any; adminChecked: boolean; isLoading: boolean; loginWithRedirect: (opts?: any) => void; } if (!roleInfo?.isModerator) { return ( <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-4"> <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground" /> <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Access Denied</h3> <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center max-w-xs"><strong>{user.email}</strong> has no staff privileges.</p> </div> ); } // Build tab list based on role const subTabs = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: BarChart3, show: true }, { id: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: Users, show: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ClipboardList, show: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, { id: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: Megaphone, show: roleInfo.isAdmin }, { id: 'tabs', label: 'Hub Tabs', icon: Layers, show: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { id: 'settings', label: 'Site Controls', icon: Settings, show: roleInfo.canManageSite }, ].filter(t => t.show); const roleMeta = ROLE_META[roleInfo.role ?? ''] ?? ROLE_META.Moderator; return ( <div className="space-y-4"> <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border ${roleMeta.color}`}> {roleMeta.icon} <span>{roleInfo.role}: {user.email}</span> </div> {/* Permission chips */} <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"> {[ { label: 'Manage Users', on: roleInfo.canManageUsers }, { label: 'Manage Admins', on: roleInfo.canManageAdmins }, { label: 'Manage Site', on: roleInfo.canManageSite }, { label: 'Manage Hub', on: roleInfo.canManageHub }, { label: 'View Audit Log', on: roleInfo.canViewAuditLog }, ].map(p => ( <span key={p.label} className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium ${p.on ? 'bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}> <t.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{t.label} </button> ))} </div> <AnimatePresence mode="wait"> <motion.div key={adminSubTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}> {adminSubTab === 'overview' && <AdminOverview roleInfo={roleInfo} />} {adminSubTab === 'users' && <UserManager myRole={roleInfo?.role} />} {adminSubTab === 'audit' && <AuditLogViewer />} {adminSubTab === 'announcements' && <AnnouncementManager />} {adminSubTab === 'tabs' && <TabManager />} {adminSubTab === 'settings' && <SiteControls />} </motion.div> </AnimatePresence> </div> ); const roleGuide = [ { role: 'Owner', color: 'text-yellow-400', icon: '👑', perms: 'Full control — promote/demote admins, delete any user, all settings' }, { role: 'Admin', color: 'text-primary', icon: '🛡️', perms: 'Manage moderators & users, hub content, site settings, announcements' }, { role: 'Moderator', color: 'text-purple-400', icon: '🔰', perms: 'View users, ban/unban regular users, view audit log' }, ]; return ( <div className="space-y-5"> <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3"> {stats.map(s => ( <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{s.icon}</div> <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</div> <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{s.value}</div> </div> ))} </div> <div className="bg-muted/40 border border-border rounded-xl p-4"> <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">🔐 Role Hierarchy</p> <div className="space-y-2"> {roleGuide.map(r => ( <div key={r.role} className="flex items-start gap-3"> <span className="text-lg">{r.icon}</span> <div> <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${r.color}`}>{r.role}</span> <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.perms}</p> </div> </div> ))} </div> </div> </div> );
